review_title: So far I am pleased with this set, having sensitive skin, it works for me
review_text: First, this Beard Growth Kit, 10 In 1 Beard Kit For Men with Beard Oil, Beard Balm, Beard Conditioner set offers a nice number of items if you are considering a gift this holiday season (or any time). It’s a nice box, again, offers a good number of items for a gift, and is done nicely enough in box set up and presentation it would be well received. Second, the items in it are a good range of “quality” so I think it’ll be appreciated. What I am saying: the brush, comb, bag, scissors, and guard are decent, but not great quality. You can get better quality, but for working needs and for a gift, this is pretty good. But, for example the scissors feel a bit cheaper. But they will get use as long as they cut well enough. I’m not big into using a guard, but this one is like others I’ve had. The included bag is decent, but I’d never use it; if traveling or moving my stuff I’d use a toiletry bag. The brush is not as nice as others I have, but it’s useable and gets the job done. Same with the comb. That brings us to the shampoo, Conditioner, and oil. NOTE: I have extremely sensitive skin, so this review is based on my experience from that standpoint. I like a range of scents or items to keep my beard in good shape, but I have a far more difficult time finding things that work and are okay on my skin. I have only used these items once, but that’s all it takes to know. I come away happy - they all worked and NO reaction. I used the shampoo and conditioner in the shower today and they not only had a nice, light scent, but I was bale to let it sit on the beard for a few minutes each, having no issues with skin and liking the smell. The beard felt soft following and I liked how they worked overall. Next, the oil. I believe it is claimed to be used for “beard growth,” and maybe it’ll help with that. My beard is decent, but I do have spots that could use thickening, so again, I keep an eye open for options. However, there is no way to know if it’ll work for that for a few weeks if not months. So until then, it again did fine on my skin - not a single ounce of negative reaction. The sect is light, so it’s nice to smell, but one (my wife) has to get up close to smell it. I do like it that way, so it doesn’t bug my sinuses or overwhelm. In the end I’m very happy so far with this Beard Growth Kit, 10 In 1 Beard Kit For Men with Beard Oil, Beard Balm, Beard Conditioner set and happy I grabbed it. I’ll use it and if all stays well, would consider getting it again.

review_title: So far this is working well for my sensitive skin; will see how it goes in the long run
review_text:
First off, I have extremely sensitive skin overall, but especially on my face. To that end, I must be very carefully about what I put on. I do tend towards lighter or no scents, but have found some that work alright for me. But with or without scent, I can still have issues. In the end, it’s how my skin handles anything that is the bottom line for me. In this case, this Provence Beauty Beard Oil - All Natural Fragrance Free Olive, Sunflower & Jojoba Oils works well for me and so far, I’m very pleased.

I use a derma roller a couple times a week to help with hair in my beard and front of my head. At this point I then add a beard oil to these locations to help stimulate growth. Without doing major testing with all the elements, like a control group (area) of my head, it’s hard to say what works and what doesn’t. I feel like the derma roller has a large part in how well growth or at least slowing of loss goes. But, I have also come to believe some of these oils available do play a supportive role. To that point, I won’t be able to speak about this Provence Beauty Beard Oil - All Natural Fragrance Free Olive, Sunflower & Jojoba Oils for awhile. I have only just begun to use it - as a replacement for another oil.

But I do like that 1. it’s not too oily on my hair or skin, 2. has little to no real scent, 3. feels fine and is not a problem on my skin, and 4. that it washes off my hands easily post application. Right now I like it as an oil providing at least some softening to my beard. Will it aide growth? We shall see...

review_title: I really wanted to like this and I do, except, my sensitivities can’t take it
review_text:
I will fully admit up front, I have a very bad sensitivity to scents. In my years of life I’ve only found maybe half a dozen I can put up with. I usually avoid them - but because I enjoy them - I do try to find ways to use it. Because of these sensitivities I try not to “blame” the product, unless it burns - then I have to question what all is in there. In this case, I decided to try Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty 2.4 Ounce is a Medium Shine because of other reviews - I was hoping... but sadly, nope, I can’t do it. So I’m giving it 4 stars 1. because I do like the smell, but 2. it lasts far too long, smelled like it got stronger than lighter, and in the end, was too much for me. I got the Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty 2.4 Ounce is a Medium Shine and both my wife and I liked the smell, but immediately worried it would be too much based on first sniffs. I put it on, and it worked great. It’s easy to put on - only a small amount covered my hair easily - and smelled nice. It was easy to work with my hair and it looked great. But as time went on, this Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty started to smell more and more and more. The smell did not dissipate, but grew. And my head started to really hurt.
In the end, I do like this Atlas Semi Matte Texture Putty 2.4 Ounce is a Medium Shine for how it works and how it looks. But for sensitive guys, you need to be aware, this putty has a strong scent - in my case at least, too strong. I won’t be able to keep using it.

review_title: It’s a decent idea, it worked, but not with the included suction cups
review_text:
I drive my wife nuts when I trim my beard in the bathroom - I try to catch all the clippings, but without something like this, it does not work well. I thought I”d give this a try - it seems like a great idea, but...

1. It arrived with 1 plastic bib, 2 suction cups with hooks, and 1 shaving cream brush.
2. The plastic bib feels okay - it’s a thin plastic, but it should last for a decent amount of time. It is not as nice as most of the kinds I’ve experienced or we own for haircutting
3. Its stitching is okay - I think it’ll last decently
4. There are two loops on the ends you will attach to the suction cups.
5. The suction cups - are worthless. This is why it gets the 4 stars - I would have given it 3 stars if we didn’t have our own suction cups to use instead of theirs. One of the two that came with it stuck for 5 - 10 seconds before it stopped working altogether. The other suction cup doesn’t even look right - it looks like it never worked and was not made properly.
6. We have suction cups (bought on Amazon) we were able to use - I looped that part of the bib onto them, which worked, but not designed for this, they would fall off. I’ll end up taping them to it - at least that way I’ll be able to use it.
7. It fit me fine. It felt fine - just like a haircut cape. The white looks weird - I’m used to the far more common black - but at the same time I think it’ll show the beard hair really well.
8. I did notice that as I go in closer to the mirror to see what I’m doing it folds over in front of me and isn’t as trapped out - be aware of this because it’s easy to start missing the catch in the bib.

Overall it’s a decent thing to have and it’ll make my wife happy not getting the beard clippings all over the place. This could be a little nicer - a little thicker plastic, much better suction cups - which would easily earn it a 5 star rating. But for what it is, I’m happy to have it. If it lasts, it’ll be great.

This is the second set of different colors of this brand I have purchased and they are decent nail polish.  The colors go on strong and go good with nail art.  There is a bit of a funky odor but it's nail polish so you would expect an odor.  It did not take long to dry and the colors are great.

This Kissio 9 eye-shadows pack is really nice! But the fun part is watching the shadow holder spin in circles in your palm. Once you open it, the spinning stops. So fun! There's 9 gorgeeeeeeeous sparkly colors to wear. I'll probably wear the majority of them over time. They're really nice and super easy to apply! Now that I'm retired, I don't wear makeup everyday so this pack will last me a long time. The shadows look nice and stay on for quite awhile before melting in the 90+ degree weather that were experiencing which created a drought here. But these eye shadows will definitely brighten up your day! I like them!

review_title: A Very Versatile Mist Spray Bottle
review_text: These Scoot just spray bottles are fabulous for many uses. Most people use them for spraying beauty products, plants, hair spray, etc. However, I ordered them for my artwork to spray watercolor paint, inks, and acrylics. What I love about them is the fine mist and that you can see what product it contains. Also, once filled, you can turn the lock so there's no leaking. A very versatile plastic water spray bottle!

This Dance Midnight perfume by Shakira is really luscious and sexy! It has a strong floral and musk scent which is a heavier scent. It's very mysterious and breath takingly good. I love it! Even the bottle is sexy. It's a heavier scent that I usually love to wear during fall and winter. In spring and summer I will wear a lighter floral scent. I've worn this perfume 3 times now and get compliments each time. Usually from my husband too. I love this perfume!

The rhinestones in these "flowers" don't catch the light very well, so only one really looked sparkly in the light.  Each clip has a bottom, 3.75" long clip (with about 3" of that for holding hair) with three 1" long clips (with 0.75" of that for holding hair) attached to it's top. The springs are strong, so they'll hold hair well. However, they're so strong that I have difficultly working them on my own hair. The "flowers" are also felt or some kind of stiff cloth glued to the plastic clip, so the "flowers" may come off with use.

review_title: Works to dry drippy hair faster after a shower
review_text: The package contained 3 microfiber Towel Wrap Turbans: one pink, one lavender, and one striped (orange, pink, blue, white). They are 26" in length. After a shower, I've wanted to wrap my long hair up in a towel for a while because otherwise it drips down my back as it dries. But I've never mastered getting a towel to stay in place. This product does help: place the large "hood" section in place on your head, tuck your hair into the tail then twist the tail one or two times, and secure the elastic loop over the button. It stays in place okay as long as you don't try to pull a shirt on over it (or similar activity). I put it on for about 20 minutes after my shower, and the Wrap is pretty wet when I take it off. My hair's still damp, but it dries much faster after that and doesn't drip down my back. So it works.

If you're looking for wooden paddle brush for long, fine hair, then this one may be just what you need.

This brush is well constructed. It's made entirely of bamboo (the handle, body & bristles). However, the bristles are smooth. This results in a very sturdy brush that can easily work through tough tangles, but without causing unnecessary breakage.

And the price is right (under $8.00 with Prime at the time of this review).

If there's any downside then it would probably not the best brush to use on wet hair with a blow dryer because it's not designed for air flow.

However, if you're looking for a good, sturdy paddle brush to use on dry hair, then this is the one for you.

review_title: Not Really Sure Who This Brush Is For
review_text:
While this is a nice looking & seemingly well designed brush, I'm not really sure who it's best suited for.

My wife has been in search of a brush for fine hair. And while this brush is described to work on fine hair, it barely even brushed through the surface of her hair.

The bristles are so soft that it can't really grip. So just kind of glides over.

It may be useful more as a beard brush, but unfortunately, that's not what it's being sold as.

Giving it 2 stars for being a well made brush (wood handle is very nice), but just not very useful for its intended purpose, brushing!

review_title: Dependable Mary Kay.. at a good price
review_text: Dependable product from Mary Kay.  I was tempted to save money for a cheaper product, but after 20 yrs and many compliments, I will stay with this product.

If you want to take a simple outfit to the next level, this is a quick and easy way to do it. They can be pinned to a jacket or blouse, and there is also a thick elastic band so that they can be added to a ponytail. They also look nice on some purses. They are stiff so they can handle storing several in one container. Some of the petals are made of a sheer fabric and others are opaque, which adds interest to the look. I have many of these in different colors, and I enjoy wearing them often.

review_title: Adds a little extra to any outfit.
review_text:
These flowers feel stiff and so they aren’t easily crushed and bent out of shape. They have a pin for wearing on clothing, and a thick, sturdy covered elastic for wearing with a ponytail.
I have several colors that help me add just the right amount of interest to several types of outfits. I’ve received many compliments while wearing them.
Not as expected

review_title: I have brunerr hair (with gray n it) but my eyebrows are a different thing
review_text: I'm just missing, thick eyebrows - I do have hair, but you an see through them...not enough hair.  This kit helps me feel as if younger than my 65 years!  Pick an eyebrow "style," use the frame and included pencil and I have eyebrows again!

review_title: If you have patches of coarse hair now that you are older...
review_text: My grandmother had issues with patches of dark, coarse hair on her face/chin area as she got older and apparently I have genetically inherited that problem.  Therein lies the problem with using this appliance.  I must shave before using this thing and then I get to be "pinched" over and over on that sensitive skin where I just shaved...I mean, if you find something hurting you, do you go back to it willingly?  No...at least when I let the stubble get long enough and then wax, the pain from yanking that wax off is much faster and less painful that this light-pulsing machine.  So, that said, it's just not the way to get rid of hair for me.  If I had just a few hairs in one spot, maybe, but not the way the hair grows on my face/chin area.

This bottle I bought to put a scant teaspoon into my home made ice cream to keep it from forming ice crystals after storing in the freezer.  I just bought a Cuisinart Ice Cream Machine and followed a simple recipe for chocolate ice cream, but I wanted to make sure that it would not become hard and full of ice crystals once I stored it in the freezer, so I did some research online and glycerin is one of several ways to keep ice cream creamy.  It only takes a teaspoon in the recipe and the other thing about glycerin is that it is sweet, so it blends in well with an ice cream recipe.  My ice cream turned out great and it is smooth and creamy after being in the freezer.  Now, this is not my first use of glycerin as I have used a small amount in water to spray in my hair.  Especially on really humid days when my naturally curly hair turns into a frizz-ball, spraying my hair with a 10 parts water, 1 part glycerin (or even less glycerin, depending) keeps my hair from frizzing out so bad.  For me, in ice cream or in my hair, glycerin works great!

review_title: I got this bag for foot issues
review_text: I do suffer from some foot issues and use heat/shiatsu massage on my feet for circulation issues, but these salts are for relieving pain when dissolved in very warm water in my foot bath/massager.  Okay, news-flash, I am a senior and not as active as I used to be but I am also very aware of keeping good circulation in my feet and making them feel as good as possible - arthritis in several joints means if I can lessen pain anywhere, I'll do that and my feet are important.  I can truly say that these magnesium salts really do make my feet feel so much better when dissolved in the foot bath water.  Because of my knees, I don't take baths any longer, but if I could easily sit down and get back up in the bath tub, I'd definitely try these salts in a nice long soak in the tub - I can imagine my whole body feeling as good as my feet afterwards!  Considering the amount I use in my footbath, this is not a bad price at all either.  When I use up this bag, I will be buying it again.

review_title: Just what I needed for my old furgirl
review_text: I have a rescued teacup poodle that is a frightened little diva when I try to groom her.  I don't think the people who took care of her were nice or gentle with her in any way.  Poor little thing is only 4.5 pounds and she's fairly old and toothless so it's not like she'd turn and bite anyone trying to keep her looking like the pretty little girl she is.  I got this brush for her fine, curly hair.  She is a sweet little girl, but will "bleat" if she thinks you intend to hurt her and the first time I put a brush to her, she was shivering like I was going to do something bad to her.  I talked to her and took my time and by the time I was done, she was relaxed and let me work on her a little at a time.  My other furgirl is an older, rescued papillion and because her fur is straight with no undercoat, this brush works great on her.  She doesn't mind the brush at all and I think she likes how it lightly "scratches" her skin at the same time. Great brush for my two old girls!

review_title: My first time using a detangling brush
review_text: I have curly hair - very, very fine, but curly hair.  Because my hair is so fine, I cannot use traditional combs or brushes when my hair is either wet or dry.  I mean, all I have to do is one "flip" or have the wind move my hair once and the knots are there.  For many years, after shampooing my hair, I used a very wide pick to comb through my hair.  Even with a pick I have to go slowly since I will find at least one knot in my hair.  Anyway, this is my first time using a detangling brush and it's not a bad deal.  I still have to go slow, but I like how it goes through my hair more fully than the pick.  Definitely worth a try if you have curly hair!

review_title: What a great set for my grandchildren
review_text: I remember my own children when they were small and how difficult it can be to ensure they all brushed their teeth at least twice a day - and spent a reasonable amount of time doing it.  I don't try to interfere with how my son raises his children, but I gave this to him so his kids, my grandkids, could have the potential for better hygiene than my kids had.  I have a similar one that I use myself and think this irrigator is a great way to ensure that they get good reports when visiting the dentist.  Great price for this small, portable unit that comes with its own travel bag.

review_title: I had originally thought I might give this as a gift
review_text: But I had to open it and spray some on my hand...and that was it.  I love the deep, spicy-sweet scent of this perfume.  It was a few hours before bed when I sprayed this and when I went to bed, I had my arm up near my nose - oh, it smelled so good and helped me relax and fall asleep!  Okay, so maybe that's not what you think of when looking for a great new perfume to wear, but it's not that it made me sleepy - it's just that it smelled so good I relaxed quickly and that allowed me to fall asleep.  This would have been a great gift for one of my daughters in law, but no...I can't give it away!  If you like that deep, spicy-sweet scent of certain perfumes, try this one.  So worth it!

review_title: I have tried the drills that have batteries in the body of the drill
review_text: And while they don't seem to be bad, they just don't have the power that this one does.  I'm thinking it has to do with the size/strength of the battery in the drill's attached power supply.  While I do use this for my fingernails, I am using it more for my toenails and feet.  Toenails are thick and tough and I have trouble cutting them well even with good toenail clippers so being able to file them a little at a time is much easier.  Also, I have some very hard, thick skin on my feet and "grinding" that skin down is much easier that using a foot file.  This is a wonderful nail drill that's not just for nails - sturdy like a workhorse, it will make short work of messy nails or hard, callused skin.

review_title: I took a chance, but again, I was wrong
review_text: See, I have naturally curly hair.  The issue is when the weather is very dry over a few days' time, my hair goes flat.  Curly hair curls a LOT in humid weather; hence, the frizz which we deal with!  Anyway, I saw these and thought that maybe during those really dry winter days these would assist me in getting my hair to curl as it should.  Now, the problem is, curly hair "fights" with some hair items - from my younger years my sisters used bristle curlers (they had straight hair) but the first time I tried using them, my hair like BIT INTO those bristles and man, I nearly had to cut my hair off to get those demon curlers out of my hair!  These are similar, apparently to the bristle, demon curlers as they grabbed a hold of my wet hair and when I tried to pull one off, even holding onto the hair at my scalp, I could feel the tube holding onto my hair for dear life.  That was with WET hair...I'm glad I did not wait for my hair to dry before attempting to pull the tube off!  I have several friends with longer, straight hair and I'm sure they will have a different, happier and more comfortable experience than I did.  What I'm saying is that I'm sure they work - for those with straight hair.  If you have curly hair, best be careful when using them!

review_title: Works well for what I need
review_text: Yeah, I have a physical job that requires I wear a mask while working.  I work in an non-air-conditioned warehouse so I sweat...having a headband that can catch some of the sweat trying to drip into my eyes helps, but now with having to wear the mask, having the buttons on the headband allows me to combine the two instead of having to try to hook the mask's elastic behind my ears and then pull the headband over my ears and getting it situated on my forehead.  Life has changed and finding the best way to work with the new normal is the only way to go...and this headband is working for me - maybe it will work to make it easier for others!

But I have baby-fine hair that is also curly.  I always have hair around the hairline that will NOT lay flat or blend into the rest of my hair whether it is pulled back or down.  Oh, and don't even get me started on humid/rainy days.  Curly hair, especially baby-fine curly hair, frizzes like crazy in humidity.  So yeah, I could spray the crap out of my hair with hairspray and have one great helmet head with not a hair out of place, but I absolutely hate hairspray.  Besides, that would require washing my hair every time I coat it with hairspray - the problem is baby-fine, dry hair isn't made to be washed daily.  So...I have lived with all those crazy "free-wheeling" hairs until trying this product.  It worked so well I was amazed and it did not leave my hair feeling like a hair helmet!  I used the mascara-like wand around the hairline from one ear to the other and those little hairs stayed in place!  Cool beans!  I will buy this again, definitely.

review_title: I decided not to cut my hair this summer
review_text: Usually I get a "summer cut" so that my hair doesn't make me any hotter during the summer months, but with the pandemic and all the salons closed, my hair is going to stay long over the hot summer months.  I can do many things with it and one is to keep it away from my face with these headbands.  I like the colors and the headbands themselves hold firmly in place which is just what I wanted.  I have some that had a twist in them and for some reason, they don't hold in place on my head very well like these do.  Colorful, comfortable to wear, and keeps my hair back - that's all I can ask for!

review_title: This is an all-inclusive package for those wanting to get into gel nail polish
review_text: I mean, you aren't starting with tons of colors or anything, but when you are new to gel nail polish, keeping it simple is the best way to begin the process.  The two colors are nice, but I am sure once a person starts gel polish, they will love it and buy a set of colors that suit them.  Now, the only thing I would change about this set is the UV light as it is very small.  I already had a larger one and am comfortable using my big one as I can fit all four fingers under it with ease.  Not that I have fat fingers or anything, but I just feel the included UV light is a tad smaller than most women would like.  Other than that, this kit will get absolutely anyone started properly in the gel nail polishing procedure.

review_title: I've been using this a few days
review_text: And it is working to soften up my feet.  As a kid I used to walk around barefoot outside all the time.  Asphalt in summer does things to your feet...so over the years I've had problems with calluses built up over time.  I put this on my feet and went to bed the first night.  Put it on again in the morning and have been doing that regularly over the past few days.  It does soften the hard, dry skin on my feet.  The scent is a bit funky - eucalyptus and menthol are not my favorites, but considering it is my feet...I can handle that.  Good cream for feet!

I have very, very fine but very curly hair and am always trying to tame some little wisp of hair that refuses to stay in one place.  These clips are about the only type of clips that work well in keeping my wispy hair in place for any length of time.  The only thing that was a problem with these is that the side of the plastic these came in had torn and they were all over the shipping box.  I mean aaalllll ooovvvveeerrr inside the shipping box.  What a pain to pick all of these up...but I believe I got them all.  I do love these little clips and love all the bright colors that I can use for spring and summer.

review_title: I bought this and another set for my niece to put on me
review_text: My niece is a professional and this is my way of getting professional work done without paying what she makes at her shop!  Of course, she does stuff like this for me and her mom (my sister) every once in a while when we ask!  So I got this and another tray for her to put on me and this tray was not really appropriate for my eyelashes - they were just a bit too thin to use on me.  The other tray worked much better so next time I will not get this set.  I'm hoping she can use it on another client of hers...might work for others, just not for me.

review_title: Followed the instructions above and got great results
review_text: I think part of it is choosing a good black under polish prior to adding the mirror powder as it needs that dark base to really shine and look like chrome.  I chose the dark blue to try first and it looked stunning when done!  The part I hate with gels is getting them off, but I'll work on getting better at that.  I love the tangerine chrome powder and will be trying that next!  These are gorgeous colors and I will be trying each of them in turn.

review_title: I haven't worn the pearl-covered ones
review_text: But I have worn all the rest!  I love how these look on my head and they do a great job of keeping my hair back from my face when I'm working around the house.  I mean, I've used scrunchies to pull my hair up on my head, but after a little while that hurts my scalp.  These are gentle on both my hair and my scalp and they do look good (at least to me) on my head!

review_title: It does work...maybe not as well as they would like you to believe
review_text: Trying to get this right is the problem - it's an issue that can't be glossed over.  If you can do it right, it looks nice, but the chances are, you will move along your eyebrow with this "pencil" and it will look goofy.  I don't mean that you shouldn't try if that's what you want, but I'd rather just have a regular eyebrow pencil.  That is easier to use and generally produces decent results for me.

review_title: These are nice for keeping hair back and look good doing it
review_text: I like having longer hair, but unless I braid it every time I want to do some work (or pin it up), it gets in my way.  I mean, if I'm trying to move a chair from one room to another and when I lean down to grab the chair, I also get a handful of my own hair which also covers my face blocking my sight.  Like my hair, hate that it gets in my way.  I have a few different things - scrunchies is one, but sometimes I don't want to wear them...so, I got these headbands for an alternative and they work great!  They keep my hair back just enough so I can work without it getting in my way.  These twist headbands also look pretty while holding my hair back.  Worth a try if you also have hair that sometimes gets in the way!

Liquid body washes are my favorites, but some seem to dry my already dry skin out so that right after my shower, I have to slather on lotion to keep my skin from feeling tight and dry.  Not so with this one!  First, it smells so good - love the orange scent that envelopes the shower!  Second, a small dollop on my scrubby lathers up well and cleans thoroughly without having to add any more to the scrubby (like other body washes).  Last, when I step out to dry off, my skin feels hydrated and soft.  I really like this body wash!

I have very, very fine hair - meaning that each strand of my hair is exceptionally thin/fine.  I have a LOT of hair, but because my hair is so fine, I have trouble with wispy strands  coming loose at the wrong places.  These type of clip work really well to keep my wispies corralled.  Granted, these are very brightly colored, but I have a few of the kind that blend into my hair.  What I was looking for was something that coordinated with what I was wearing so that I could "celebrate" my hair with the bright colors of these clips.  I mean, why hide "difficult" hair issues?  Or maybe hiding it in plain sight when wearing a Christmas-y red dress with red hair clips!  If you have wispies that escape and make your up-do look messy, maybe you too could try bright clips to celebrate your wild and crazy hair!

That's basically what this is.  First off, the box is written in Chinese, I believe, with absolutely no English on it.  No instructions other than a pair of pictures.  Not great pictures either.  Not to be deterred, I opened the box, pulled one of the razors from the box, removed the plastic cover and tried it.  If you look closely at the one picture, you will see what appears to be a drop of blood - it is.  That is why I described this as a straight razor with a guard in quotes.  Make NO mistake, these are SHARP.  Use them delicately and only on smooth skin.  If you have a blemish, a mole or anything just slightly raised on your skin, it will be cut off.  You will bleed.  Just want others to be aware of what this is and to take care not to hurt themselves.
Absolutely beautiful craftsmanship, easy to grip with hands, and I love the fact that this is bigger than commercial toothbrushes feels nice !

We use this for those between shower clean ups.  It is easy to use and very gentle and soothing.  Has not caused any issues.  Can really be used anywhere as it is plenty gentle enough.  Does a good job of getting rid of sweaty stink and leaves you feeling just showered fresh.  This would be great for travel as well as home use.

These bits work well and are compatible with all the nail drills I tried.  The bits are good quality and seem like they should last a long time as long as you don't abuse them.  The set has some unusual bit profiles that we found very useful, especially for tighter spots or smaller nails.  The case keeps everything safe, in one place, and secure.

This is a great nail set.  It has all the bits you need to get started.  It is well made and spins at a high RPM (12000?)  Easy to swap out bits and the wand is easy to handle and great for fine detailed work.  I only use it on top speed but it does have 3 seed total and can be reversed if needed.  The battery holds a charge well and is enough to do a pair of hands.  Recharge takes about an hour.

We tried this out and so far it is working.  We have a noticeable reduction in the amount of hair in the tested areas.  It does take several weeks and several sessions to notice a difference.  Plan on at least a half hour per session (depending on how large of an area you are doing.  Make sure to wash after and use some skin lotion.  Follow the directions for skin and hair type and you should see good results.

I'm not usually a fan of flower scented sprays, but my wife loves them so we gave this a try.  I was shocked at how well I enjoyed this scent. Saw this puppy discussed a lot on various shaving sites. They all said that you have to watch the YouTube videos to get the right technique for lathering. I watched a couple and have been trying this now for the past several weeks. I must have tried close to 40 different soaps, creams and sticks from the most expensive to the not so expensive. This one is right up there in terms of face glide and lubrication.Certainly in the top quintile. Why 4 stars? I have tried every variation to get a lather but there is no getting around that this is the most difficult soap I have ever tried. Too much water, too little water it seemed impossible to get it right the first time. No matter what I tried it seemed to either be too foamy and thin or not enough water to generate a lather. It's as if the gremlin in the soap puck was contrary enough to defeat whatever I tried until the 2nd or 3rd try.
Bottom lime- With effort and persistence it gets the job done and the fragrance is mildly pleasant but it will never be my "go-to" product. I'll stick with may favs: Kiss My Face, Cella and Proraso cream.
UPDATE:
Gave it another try with a little more patience. It seems that the end product you want is a little on the thick creamy side and not really a "lather". If you wet your brush, turn it over and let all the water drip out that you can,then you apply brush to soap and be patient and determined you will get the thick rich cream that will do the trick. One other tip I found after you apply the cream to the face let it sit for about 20-30 seconds before you apply your razor. You will then get the greatest glide you will experience. Accordingly I have moved it up the top tier and displaced the Proraso cream.I would give it 4 1/2 stars, and not 5, if I could because of the difficult lathering.
FURTHER UPDATE
After using this puppy for a little while I have come to master it and love it. Great for glide and closeness and absence of irritation. I originally rated it a 4 but now after careful consideration I must admit that it deserves a 5 star rating. Its among my top 3 favorite shaving products.

The curling iron gets up to 410 degrees max, which works pretty well on my thick hair.  I've tried fixing my hair in different ways after using it, to see which method holds the curls longer.  I still have an issue with my hair losing the curls a bit to quickly but it's remedied by using styling products before and after curling it.  To be honest, I think this beach waver is very overpriced.  Maybe the results would be better for someone with thinner hair but I don't think I'd pay more than $50 for this curling iron.  Nice results, but the design flaws make this a product I won't reach for that often.

review_title: I'm not sure this is worth the price asked...
review_text: I've always wanted to get into the art of doing my own acrylics so when I saw this drill set, I knew I had to review it.  Firstly, it comes with numerous accessories- a fluffy brush for removing dust from the nail and work area, a set of to separaters for painting, a nail board, and the drill bits themselves.  The entire set is nicely packaged and comes nestled in a velvety foam materials.  The bits are held in their own clear container within the box.  The set comes with a detachable adapter that plugs into the end of the drill and then into the wall outlet.  The drill itself is small enough to handle pretty easily, although I can see where it would be difficult for someone with smaller hands than myself (I have large hands.)  Inserting and removing the bits can be a challenge.  The mechanism isn't well made so I have to fight with it.  The power cord is much too short and I had to use an extension cord to give myself some wiggle room away from the wall outlet.  Some of the bits' textures do a better job than the others, while some don't do anything at all.  The over all look and feel of the set isn't worth the price, in my opinion.  It works a bit too awkwardly to be something I'd use that often.

I really enjoy this UV lamp.  It's sleek design and concept make it easy to use.  I like the buttons designated for each separate drying time and the LED display is easy to read and understand.  It works like a champ and does a great job!  I truly think this lamp is worth the price, and I think you'll like it as much as I do.

These are great cotton rounds!  I used to get the CVS 360 brand but they were getting expensive because I used a few each day.  Luckily, I found this huge pack of awesome rounds.  They are super soft but not so soft that they don't hold up when wet.  They are fantastic when you don't want to waste product because they absorb just the right amount and actually extend the life of my products.  The price is low and the amount of cotton rounds in this big pack can't be beat!

These are good for those late nights when you’re too exhausted to do your whole routine, although I HIGHLY recommend doing a quick double cleansing regardless.  They seem to remove dirt but don’t work well for removing oil-based makeup.  Make sure to understand that this has to be rinsed off, or you’re falling asleep with soap on your face.  I won’t be repurchasing.

This kit is a great deal!  I've been a devoted user of Korean skin care products.  For a while, I have preferred, out of several brands and types of sheet mask, the Benton Bee and Snail sheet mask.  Fantastic product!!!!  Firms, smooths, soothes.  It's great.  However, that's not why I purchased this set.  I have combo skin that leans towards oily in the heat.  Super oily T-zone.  After doing a ton of research, I decided to give the Benton Aloe Gel moisturizer a try.  I'd also heard great things about this foam cleanser.  I'm really enjoying the cleanser so far.  I wet my hands and face, use only a pea sized amount, rub my hands together to create the foam (not a soapy lather, but a thick and creamy foam), and work over my face.  I do this after oil cleansing.  This does a great job of picking up any oil residue and dirt, while leaving my face soft and refreshed.  Never tight and dry, which is the sign of an awful cleanser.  The gel moisturizer is okay.  Just okay.  I don't get as oily as I did with lotion moisturizers, which is great.  However, I don't have that supple, smooth feel that I'm used to and prefer.  I've actually noticed flaking around my nose, which is something I never dealt with after moisturizing.  A pea sized amount covers my entire face, it leaves a slightly tacky finish until absorbed ( I always let each of my products absorb for around 90 seconds before applying the next step), and is completely colorless.  Will I repurchase?  No, but I do suggest that you give this a try if your research and needs point you this direction.  Everyone's skin care needs can vary on several levels.  There are universal musts for good skin health, like cleansing daily, moisturizing, and using a good sunscreen.  There a a ton a variations of those products, though.  Finding the right routine and products can be a trial and error process.  The main thing is to stick to it.  The results are worth it!

This is a very nice magnifying mirror, in a beautiful oil rubbed bronze finish!  Especially for the price point!  There were very similar items for twice as much, but I'm so glad I chose to purchase this one for our bathroom.  My husband is starting to get more gray in his beard than not, and has been having trouble seeing it all while shaving.  I got this for him (and for myself, but don't tell him) and he has been thrilled with it.  The three lighting choices are gorgeous and very useful, as is the 10x magnification side of the swivel mirror head.  I'm thinking of getting one for my mom and sister, as well.  Great buy!

review_title: Best clips for long, fine hair!
review_text:
My hair is long and very fine/slippery, so I generally find that jaw clips are too small to hold all of my hair, too large/weak to keep my hair from slipping loose, and/or too heavy and fall off off my head under its own weight. These clips address all issues fabulously: the long but narrow shape captures all of my hair but clamps it closely enough that the strands don’t slip free and the lightweight nature means that gravity won't pull the clip loose. I can use these clips for both a full bun (I do need to double my long hair over to fit in the clip) or a half-up style.

I do object to calling the shade of these “wine red” when the product picture is plainly some kind of magenta shade. The actual clips are darker and mauvier than pictured and certainly pretty, but a far cry from “wine red” still.

I don't find the dry shampoo powder itself to be much better than plain cornstarch or arrowroot flour, especially as a product for blondes. But, the squeeze top dispenser is excellent. I would not repurchase this, but plan to reuse the container for DIY powder dry shampoo.

Speaking as someone with black hair who did not realize this product was for blondes when ordering, this product had more of a white cast than most dry shampoos but it wasn't a huge issue---it largely blended away once worked in thoroughly as per usual. Last I checked, the version for brunettes was more expensive, which seems ridiculous.

This is a beautiful foundation. I tried applying this both with a flocked powder puff and a foundation brush. I did prefer the powder puff, which did a better job of picking up the powder through the elasticated net dispenser. The finish is what I would call a "luminous matte" or "lit from within"---it definitely wasn't flat but didn't look dewy or greasy, either. It applied very smoothly over some very textured spots on my skin and covered blemishes well.

Unfortunately, the shade range sucks. I typically need a shade described as "very fair", which are harder to find in mineral foundations. The 100 Light shade is too dark for me unless I also cover my whole neck and chest with it, but the finish is beautiful and I honestly would wear it out on days I'm wear a scarf, for example. I would describe this shade as fair-light or light with a neutral peach undertone.

If you are familiar with the Tarte loose powder foundation, this seems very similar but without the clay that tends to oxidize. They have the same style of packaging (elasticated net + stopper lid), same luminous matte finish, and similar longevity.

As YMMV when taking someone's word on shave gear, I thought I might provide some background about me: I have gentle to oily skin and stiff, tough neck hairs. I used to think I had sensitive skin until I married someone with actual sensitive skin. But the combination of the tough hairs and the gentleness of my skin leads to irritation on the neck when I am not careful. I learned to shave with a gillette adjustable years ago(which I still use), but out of "convenience" (really, a lack of good shaving products and knowhow) I stopped using it for cartridge systems in my early twenties. Since I started shaving right, some time ago, I got an EJ-89 which I use when I'm feeling raw, and an old type open comb gillette (which, for the moment at least, I favor for its closeness- I use personna lab blue blades or sharper in it). I've tried a number of different soaps and a few creams, most of which are good. Mitchell's is excellent. It has a simple, clean smell like fresh linen and is the most thoroughly hydrating shaving product I have ever used. It lathers up easily- I've used my beat up old drugstore boar brush which is now probly 15 years old and a silvertip badger brush.. I've heard that water hardness and temp can make a difference with this stuff, but as I have decidedly soft water here in the city, I can't really comment on that. But once you get the lather right, with enough water, it is eaaasy on the face. Amazing even.. I dreamt wetshaving was like this as a teenager..
One might be put off by the price which may seem hefty for a newcomer to the wetshaving game, eager to start saving money (previously lost on walking the cartridge treadmill) and reticent to buy apparently expensive luxury shaving soaps, but aside from being a quality product, It lasts for a quite a while. I was really going to wait until I had exhausted mine to write this review but it's been a month, and the puck looks basically the same size! Growing up on Williams soap and favoring Van der Hagen as a drugstore standby these days, I notice one soap generally lasts me a month (some less than that), but aside from the simply larger size of Mitchells (4.4 oz to 2.5 oz for standard mug size soaps), you just get more bang for your buck. I'm guessing this one will last me three months or more.. So at that rate, the price basically factors out altogether.
To sum up, if you have gentle or easily irritated skin and aren't looking for a heavily scented product, this is the grail of soaps for you. One word: I wouldn't spring for the dish because I am cheap. You might not be.. But the soap itself does perfectly fit a rice bowl or large ramekin, in case you were wondering.. Probably not a mug though, unless it were seriously oversized..

review_text:
Do you see “100% Natural” and think “Yeah, right!” or do you assume it won’t work as well as products that have chemicals? I do this all the time especially when it comes to cleaning products or makeup. In this case I was offered a bottle of Pure Body Naturals™ 100% Natural Nail Polish Remover and the skeptical part of me was sure this wouldn’t turn out well. But in the spirit of trying new things, I agreed to review it and put it to the test. **See the images for before/after photos**

For my test I painted my nails several different colors. We all know deep reds are harder to get off and glitters can also be a pain to remove. I dedicated my left hand to the Pure Body Naturals™ 100% Natural Nail Polish Remover and my right hand I used a drugstore brand of acetone polish remover (the super cheap stuff I usually use.) Both hands got two good coats of polish.

To remove the polish the Pure Body Naturals™ remover instructions say to drop or dab it on and wait 2-3 minutes before wiping. For the generic acetone remover I just apply and wipe with a cotton ball.

The Pure Body Naturals™ remover wiped right off, taking most of the polish with it. I did have to reapply a small amount, wait a few more minutes and all but one tiny trace of the red polish was gone. The acetone remover left polish near my cuticles even after a hard scrubbing and a second try.

So what did I like?
-I like that it works better than the acetone remover, even on the darkest red and glitter!
-I like that it did not make my nails feel dry.
-I like that the Pure Body Naturals™ remover doesn’t have harsh chemicals.
-I like that it isn’t tested on animals.
-I like that it comes with a handy glass dropper.

The only problem (and it could have been a BIG one) is this polish will eat through any polish, including vanish on my dining room table and styrofoam plates. No kidding. I started out thinking to drip the remover over a plate to keep it off the table but it quickly melted the styrofoam and one small spot of the table varnish.

Only use this stuff in the bathroom over tile or a sink with no finish/paint/lacquer, etc. never over a delicate surface like your dining room table!

I received a free sample of this remover to review. I have given my honest opinion and the real test/comparison results.

This cream is wonderful and allows me to easily go 4-5 days on one twist out - something that many other products just don't do for my hair.

This has a really sweet, pleasant smell to it. It's a white cream that's on the thick side, but very easy to work with and absorbs nicely into the hair - doesn't just sit on top. I also love that it doesn't make my hair feel all crunchy or crispy. My twist out was really soft and my curls were bouncy. review_title: Roller Ball May Not Be the Best Mode of Application
review_text:
I've been using this serum for 5 days, AM and PM. I believe I see some minor reduction in the lines under my eyes...but it could be wishful thinking. I am not convinced there is always serum coming out while rolling it on because the nature of steel is that it feels cool to the touch, therefore can give the impression of depositing serum when, in fact, it isn't. To determine this I ran it over white tissue several times; only about 50% of the time did serum actually come out. I removed and cleaned the steel roller ball as directed then reran my "experiment" and had the same results.

During application I can briefly detect a damp look where it is being deposited, but this goes away within seconds. At other times nothing is on the surface of my face and immediate dabbing with a tissue proves there is no serum. I am not convinced this is the best mode of application.

If, after a couple of months of use, I see definite wrinkle reduction I will happily update my review accordingly.

I'm posting a pic of my hair pre-bleach, post bleach, and post pink dye. I probably didn't need to bleach it but the last time I tried to dye my hair with pinks (two different brands) it just didn't take very well.

This took very well. The kit includes all you need (I used different gloves just because I prefer others). The directions are simple and complete. I would say that if you have hair longer than chin, maybe shoulder length, you will need at least two boxes. I have a pixie cut and used about half of both the bleach and dye. I always follow the direction when bleaching and did follow their directions. I never follow directions when using these "Direct dye" bright colors. Instead of the 30-60 minutes, I left mine in for 5 hours. I got a very vibrant pink (a little more fuchsia than the pictures on the box).

My one complaint is that this definitely left me with more dye rubbing off than some other brands have. When I used other brands I might wake up the next morning to a streak light on my pillow and that was with lot of hair. Using this on short hair, my pillow looked like a pink paintball fight happened. This and all dyes like it will dye anything and everything they touch. So I highly recommend two things - 1. protect everything (your skin around your face and neck with Vaseline) 2. If possible do NOT rinse your hair in a shower/bathtub. If you have access to a stainless steel sink or some kind of utility / laundry room sink where stains won't matter, that is so much easier to clean.

review_title: Two 5 STAR and Two 4 STAR Fragrances- some are sure to please every man
review_text:
English Laundry Men's 4 Piece 20ml Coffret is a truly wonderful men’s cologne set. You are getting four fragrances- rated 4 and 5 STARS all in one box. The fragrances rated by me are based on my years spent working in a cosmetic factory. I will list each fragrance separately.

ARROGANT- With top notes of bergamot and cedar you get a woodsy freshness to the scent. The middle notes of coriander and lavender bring a warm, clean freshness. At the base are sandalwood, amber and musk bringing a warm, sensual, spicy scent. All together, you get a spicy, warm, woodsy scent with a distinctive freshness to it. This light, sensual scent lasts all day and smells wonderful on almost every man, so 5 STARS.

OXFORD BLEU- The top notes of mint and lemon add a citrus freshness. The middle notes of iris and geranium bring a very light floral scent. The base adds sandalwood and vanilla for a woodsy delicious scent. All together, this scent is light, with an undertone bit of floral and clean citrus and a nice light woodsy smell. This light, woodsy fragrance smells fabulous on almost every man and does last long for 5 STARS.

RIVIERA- With top notes of lemon, bergamot, lime and cedar, you get a refreshing citrus/woods scent. In the middle are jasmine, patchouli, vetiver, lavender and mandarin- most of these were used in the 60's sexy, warm, earthy scents. At the base notes are nutmeg and coumarin to add some spice. This is not for every man, but for a man who likes a more vibrant scent. These scents are very noticeable and not light, being a very woodsy, earthy, warm fragrance with a touch of zest. 4 STARS.

NOTTING HILL- The top notes begin with bergamot, lemon and lime for a clean, natural scent. Then the middle notes have bolder peppercorn and jasmine bringing a rose/herbal scent. At the bottom are cedarwood, sandalwood, amber and a powdery musk for a very potent woodsy, animal musky scent. This is definitely not for every man being very heavy scents. There is nothing light about this fragrance. 4 STARS.

With four interesting fragrances, two being light and two being heavy, every man is sure to find one he will like. Lighter scents always smell wonderful on almost every man and the bolder scents smell great on a man depending on how his chemistry goes with the bolder fragrances. 4 ½ STARS.

review_title: Nice salon-quality cuticle pusher with nail cleaner tool, with a minor caveat.
review_text:
I have been looking for a stainless steel cuticle pusher to use for home manicures - this one is nearly identical to the one used by my manicurist, it has a nice weight to it, is comfortable to use, and is salon-quality. I use it with the CND CuticleAway Cuticle Remover gel, and it works just as expected. The nail cleaner end is a nice touch - I prefer this style to the ones that have flat or split trimmer blade ends.

One caveat - the edge on the pusher end is sharp - you need to be careful of the pressure and angle used which pushing your cuticles back, as holding the tool at the wrong angle and/or using too much pressure may result in damage to the top layer of your nail (e.g. the tool may shave a slight bit off). I used my Dremel with a fine sanding bit to dull the edge on the pusher end; this resolved the issue for me. If you don't have a Dremel, I suggest taking an emery board to smooth the sharp end before use in order to avoid damaging your nail.

I paid FULL price for this cuticle pusher, and did not receive any incentives or discounts in exchange for this review.

review_title: Much better then the Sonic Spinbrush by Arm & Hammer
review_text:
Until a year ago, I never liked the idea of owning an electric toothbrush: I'd owned several cheap ones and never liked any of them. Then I figured that I'd try one again about a year ago and so I chose the Sonic Spinbrush by Arm & Hammer. I chose the Spinbrush because it had a large brush, which I thought meant less time/effort brushing my teeth.

The Spinbrush worked pretty well, but the large brush head gagged me horribly. Because of this, I decided to give the Oral-B Vitality a try and I like it much better. The first reason I prefer the Vitality is because it has a much smaller brush head (you don't need a large brush with an electric toothbrush, since the toothbrush is doing all the work.) The smaller brush head also allows me to reach places the larger Spinbrush cannot reach, because it's too big. The Vitality is easier to maneuver in your hand as well, thanks to the smaller handle base.

Another thing I didn't like about the Spinbrush is how it would click off automatically after 2 minutes (I don't think all models of the Spinbrush do this, though.) The Vitality purposely sputters after 2 minutes for it's timing function, but then continues it's normal operation after a second or two. I still find this annoying, but at least I don't have to remove it from my mouth, dripping with toothpaste, just to turn it back on. And if I finish early, the Spinbrush required me to punch the button twice to stop it (again, something not easy to do with a vibrating toothbrush in your mouth), whereas the Vitality only requires a single button push. These two things alone make the Vitality much more convenient.

I also think the Vitality is more powerful then the Spinbrush. The reason you had to push the button on the Spinbrush twice was so you could use it at a lower speed if necessary, but I never found that necessary at all. I prefer the more powerful Vitality, because it feels like it's cleaning better by not slowing down if I push too hard.

About the only thing I liked better about the Spinbrush was that it had an indicator light on the base to tell you it was receiving power (I think it gauged the charge, too, but that was never a problem for me.) I'm not sure if that's even important, but it is something I tend to prefer with rechargeable items. Other than that, I love the Vitality and I much prefer it over the Spinbrush. Now I can brush my teeth without gagging and I am thankful for that.

review_text:
This is not built very sturdy. T?he base of it, if only it had a metal piece to hold the bottom in place, it would be perfect...... but it has a plastic piece.......... and for this not to be sturdy, is pretty dangerous..

I bought it because I wanted to lay my mom under it as often as possible......... and it almost fell on her.............. and almost gave me a heart attack... she didn't even notice, but omg if it had fallen on her...........

Also when it showed up one of the lights was broken..... I never said anything to anyone about it though because it was for the night in the middle, and I don't really need that one........ But I probably should have just to get it replaced.

So. Red light therapy really works.......... as far as this product goes.......... the fact that it's not totally sturdy, I think is dangerous, especially if you're in my situation with an older parent......... but it was the best one I could find. I don't regret buying it, but I hope that they replace the plastic piece at the bottom with metal.

Great stuff. I have a long beard that is about 50% grey. The grey hair is coarser and less manageable than the hair that still has color. I use a little balm every day, and it has made the beard look better and feel less dry.

I'm not usually interested in grooming products, but as the beard gets greyer and longer, it was becoming apparent that it needed a little help. I think in the old days our viking ancestors oiled their beards, so I think we can use the balm and still be squared-away.

The balm is easy to use, makes no mess, and has no noticeable smell. All upside, no problems. I keep a tin at home and one at work.

I'm on my third tin, now, still liking it.

This oil is effective for taming the random parts of the beard that are going in some odd direction on any given day. It also seems to be making the beard less dry and bristly. You probably wouldn't need it on a trim beard, but those of us with manly beard start needing a little something at some point.

Like any oil, it can be annoying if you absent-mindedly stroke your beard and then touch your face with your hands. It does not irritate the eyes, so that is good, but you have to remember to go easy on the oil and pretty much keep your hands off your beard.

Modern Barbarian's beard balm is a better product for daily use in that it doesn't make your face and hands oily. The balm really does the job with no downside. This oil does a better job re: getting the beard ready to be combed into a presentable shape, but comes with the down side of being oily. I use the oil if I need to look presentable for something important, but I rub a little of the balm in every day.

review_title: Two combs, one 5 stars, one 1 star
review_text:
I bought two, one for home and one for work.

The home one is great- best comb I have ever owned, by far. Works great for the beard, and I end up using it on my hair as well.

The one at work smells awful. I let it sit for a while to air out, but that didn't help. I washed it repeatedly, but that didn't help. On one side, the surface isn't smooth - it looks like half of that side of the comb was gouged. The good comb is smooth on both sides. This one smells strongly like rotting fecal material. It isn't getting any better. I grew up with horses, and worked on a cattle ranch. I can tune out a certain amount of odor, but this is repulsive. I don't want it anywhere near my beard.

If I could be sure that this is just a random bad comb, I would buy a new one to replace it, but at this point I have one good and one bad. Those aren't good odds.

Update - I let the smelly comb sit in the back of my closet for a couple months. Every now and then I soaked Eucalyptus essential oil into the scratched up side of the comb. It doesn't smell anymore.

review_title: Grainy but perfectly fine to use
review_text:
This shea butter is a good quality shea butter. It is ivory and reasonably priced. As a person whose been using shea butter for well over 10 years for ecezma treatment I can say that this shea butter is a quality product. Although it is a quality shea butter, the way it has been processed left the butter very grainy and not as creamy as I was expecting. It is a thick, heavy butter that is solid at room temperature and has a lot of use for hair and body purposes. It is sourced from an area in Africa that doesn't produce a real rancid smelling butter. It smells distinctly like shea but not like the shea sourced from more eastern countries. The butter when applied to the skin feels thick and heavey but that isn't a problem for me. I would need to indirectly melt and re-solidify this butter in order to smooth it out and kill the grainy texture it comes with. I'd also whip this butter to make it creamy.

Price: Reasonable
Texture: Grainy but not too smooth, sort of like peanut butter but thicker
Color: Ivory, more of an off white, cream like tone
Scent: Hard to describe but it's distinctly Shea which never smells pleasing

Overall, this company's shea butter is a good quality butter, high quality for some but for me good/decent due to the fact it's grainy and doesn't have the smooth texture I'm used too. The color is normal and the butter feels thick, heavy and heavenly on thick dry skin like eczema. I'd recommend this company's shea butter and possibly repurchase in the future.

•This quality shea butter was purchased for a promotional price in exchange for my unbiased and honest review.

This iron is mediocre in performance and quality. The iron is very heavy to hold and has a semi long heat up time. This isn't an iron I'd honestly recommend and the price the company charges full price is outrageous for the quality of this iron.

My hair texture is 3C/4A and it is relaxer free. It requires high heats to lay flat. All of my irons is set to 450 degrees when in use. Before any flat ironing can begin I start with clean freshly shampooed and conditioned hair. I then blow dry, prestreching it so that it is easier to iron out. I use a blow out cream which also protects my hair from heat damage and a vented brush when blow drying. After I'll apply a argon oil serum and a frizz busting serum to my hair. These oils aide in getting my hair to lay flat with out any frizz.

Iron snagged my hair upon first use. I thought that maybe it was user error but it wasn't as the second time I ran the iron across a different section of hair it was snagged. I also had issues with my iron staying on. The placement of the on and off switch makes it very easy to turn this iron on and off while in use. The iron didn't even stay plugged in when I was using it. I was constantly giggling the cord to get it to turn back in. This iron doesn't glide down a section of hair well. It is very choppy thus leading to the snagged hair I spoke of earlier. The iron does swivel while in use making it easy to use. It goes up to 450 degrees but it's very difficult to maintain any temperature selected on this iron.

I don't recommend this iron simply due to the fact it snags at hair. It does work to smooth down hair but it doesn't work well as it cannot guide down smoothly. The only good thing about this iron is the fact it is very attractive to look at. I'm happy to say that I didn't pay full price as I received this for a promotional price. Had I paid full price I would have promptly returned this iron.

*** In exchange for my unbiased and honest review I received this iron for a promotional price.

review_title: Better than many other epilators for smooth skin
review_text:
I've tried a couple of different types of epilators over the past 15-20 years. While I was usually happy enough with the results, I rarely used them since it always seemed like you had to wait until the hair got long enough for the unit to grip the hair in order to yank it out. And rarely did I really want the hair on my legs to reach that amount of stubble. Not to mention the pain that is involved with epilators. Yes, I am a weenie.

This model of the Braun Silk Epil removes much shorter hair. It claims to remove hair that is as short as a grain of sand (0.5mm). I personally find it requires it to be a bit longer than that to grip; but it does do a much better job of reaching short hair than others I've tried. It has a pivoting head which lets it work around all your body contours. A light on the unit allows even the palest, finest hairs to be visible.

In addition to hair removal, this epilator refines your skin. A sonic massage system and high-density brush scrub away old skin cells. This exfoliation helps to stimulate the regeneration of surface skin cells in order to create a smoother skin tone. I do notice a bit of a smoother, more even skin tone on my legs now. This sonic massage is my favorite part of the device...in part because I really don't like the tweezing part.

This model can be used wet or dry and uses rechargeable batteries rather than a power cord.

Unfortunately, I find that it still hurts...although not nearly as much as it used to. With regular use, the hairs on my legs have become fewer. Plus, the already pale fine hair is becoming even thinner and weaker. Braun claims that it will keep your body free of hair for up to 4 weeks. I usually find it to be somewhere in the 2 to 3 week range for me. Still, that's nice for when you're going on vacation or heading off to the beach for a week or two. I allow the growth to get to the slight stubbly stage and then I'm perfectly smooth for a couple of weeks.

Recommendation - unless you just like the novelty and asthetics - look for a more practical razor.

I ordered this 3-pack of Salux towels for the shower to help with rough bumpy skin on the backs of my legs, and to have an easy way to scrub my back.

They take some getting used to, partially because they're so long and don't immediately lather like sponges do. I prefer to keep it folded, wet it, add some soap or shower gel, and rub/scrunch it together until a lather forms. I used it folded on my body, and then unfold it to full length to use on my back (like the picture shows). You have to keep it out of the stream of water, or else the soap will wash right out of it.

They were definitely much more harsh than I expected - I can only use them very gently, and can't use them at all on especially thin areas of skin like my shins, the tops of my feet, or my chest. I'd absolutely never use them on my face or neck.

After the first use, I noticed an immediate improvement to my bumpy skin. But after I began to scrub with them daily, I felt like it actually exacerbated the problem. Plus, it was just another item to keep in the bathroom and worry about washing every week. As a side note, I wish they made these in white or grey instead of the bright colors - I feel like they'd match so many more peoples' bathroom decor and I wouldn't feel as bad about leaving one lying around the bathroom.

Now, I just use a Salux once per week as an exfoliating treatment - they're definitely too strong to be an everyday thing for me, but it does the job and helps with my bumps overall.

Tips for use: Brush or comb hair. Depending on the desired style, it's often helpful to part hair into segments for spikes and using coated hair ties to keep the segments apart. Spray Got2b Glued liberally (your hair should feel wet) first to the roots in small segments and dry with a hair dryer on a cool setting to establish the "base" of your style. Use your hands to shape it as your dry. (For some of the longer hair, it can become a four-hand task, so get some assistance from a friend.) Once your shape is set, spray to the tips of your hair in small segments and dry each segment before doing the next. When you've spiked all segments, give your entire style one more heavy coating and dry with the dryer. For liberty spikes or other styles where you want the tips to stay tidy, apply a small amount of Got2b Ultra Glued Invisible Styling Gel (smile.amazon.com/Got2b-Ultra-Invincible-Styling-6-Ounce/dp/B004FQK7DA/) to the tips only and dry once more with the dryer.

Clean-up is also easy. Use a gentle shampoo and warm water.

review_text: I bought this brace after a fall in which I'd injured my knee, as well as my ankle, and needed to keep my knee completely immobile -- no lateral tuning or twisting at all, and restricted flexing and extension.  It was the third brace I ordered -- the first was not nearly strong enough, and the second sizing was off. I'm so glad I found this one: It's a superb brace -- fine, sturdy stays,plus hinges that let you adjust both flexion and extension. I initially thought that latter feature was something I wouldn't need, but it turns out to have made a huge difference during this first month of healing. Service has been superb, too: Before I ordered, I measured my thigh, knee and calf; I was on the cusp between sizes, and so ordered up. I wrote the seller and asked if there was a solution -- this brace was costly enough that I didn't want to have to pay out of pocket for a second one -- and they offered to send  me a smaller size. I do a lot of nail art that includes stamping, sponging and a bunch of other really messy designs. My problem is that when I do all of those things the polish gets all over my skin making clean up take a bit longer than I like. So I needed to find something that could help with that problem. In comes this liquid latex!

I ordered one in the hopes that it would help with keeping the skin around my nails clean while I'm doing those messy manicures. I cleaned out an empty nail polish bottle and filled it up with this liquid latex. Then I used the brush from the nail polish bottle to apply the liquid latex to the skin around my nails. I gave it a few minutes to dry then did my manicure. Once done with the manicure I used a little nail polish remover on a brush to make sure none of the latex was attached to the polish on my nail (don't want to ruin the manicure by pulling the polish on my nail off with the latex). Then, using tweezers, I pulled the latex off of each finger. For the most part it came off easily leaving clean up much easier with less to clean.

This was a lifesaver! I am very pleased with this liquid latex. The only thing I don't like about it is the smell, it's almost a fishy smell. It is very strong at first when applying. Once dried the smell does dissipate for the most part so it doesn't bother me that much.

Yes you do want to make sure to saturate the cotton ball you use or just apply directly but because of the consistency, a little goes a long way!

review_title: I'm a beginner at contouring. This kit was perfect for me.
review_text:
I have a very fair skin tone - my foundation range is usually ivory, or light ivory, the lightest choices. I am no makeup guru, but am intrigued with all the contouring I see going on in social media and magazines. I wanted to know more, but needed a tutorial on how to do this for my face. I liked this set because it came with instructions on how to apply correctly for a contour effect.

Each palette in this set is made up of a blush like material - there is no foundation or creamy application to it. Each shade is also matte, and does not include any pearly or sheen tint to it. The directions state to apply your regular foundation FIRST, then use this contour kit, THEN follow up with your regular blush and bronzer.

I really loved the brush that was included in the kit. It gave me much better contouring effects than any brush I have used from my makeup set before. The brush is thick and flat. Because this is a powder/blush application, this gave me noticeable contouring on my face, without being too dramatic like a foundation contour product might do that requires sponge blending. I was able to blend this powder in as much as I liked, which softened the contour look. As I get more confident in my application, I won't need to blend it in as much, but will enjoy a little more drama in the application.

Overall, this was a great product for someone like me to try out that is just getting started with contouring. For a more advanced or skilled makeup artist, I'd assume you would want more dramatic effects than this powder supplies.

review_title: Sturdily made and full of room!
review_text:
This makeup storage bag is just fantastic!

The backpack is very sturdily made and will definitely hold up to heavy use for years to come.

The zippers zip and unzip smoothly, and run in both directions, making it quicker and easier to unzip in a hurry and not worry about them getting stuck.

The main compartments are roomy, and allow multiple items to be stored inside. I took the boxes out in one photo to show the room available if you need it.

On one side you have a smaller zippered comparment which has a thermal lined pocket inside which can hold hot tools such as straighteners and curling irons, and also allows for storage of extra items such as brushes and combs, or miscellaneous items.

On the other side there is another zippered compartment which allows for more products, plus has an netted portion which opens to the outside to allow for tissues to be dispensed quickly and easily. There are slots in this pocket also which allow for small tools like scissors, combs , brushes, etc to be stored.

the top handle is sturdy and has a nice grip that's easy to hold on to and carry around.

I stored my blow dryer and some brushes in the top compartment, straightener in the side compartment, tissues in the other side, and filled all three boxes with makeup products, and then still had plenty of room left.

All compartments are extremely easy access, whether holding the backpack with one arm and grabbing something out, or sitting it on a table or chair and unzipping with one hand. I love that the front compartment is velcroed so that once unzipped, it's still easy to close quickly and will keep everything secure until you have time to zip back up.

This is fantastic whether you are a makeup artist heading to a show, or just a glamorous girl with lots of products on the go travelling.
Even at home this makes for great storage and easy accessibility.

review_text: I tried a more budget friendly at home laser hair removal device a while ago and was less than thrilled with the results, but decided to give it one more try with a better device. I'm glad I did! This is a significant improvement! I wanted to wait several weeks to write my review to see if there were results and after 6-7 weeks of use I'm definitely seeing a significant reduction in hair! The device is super easy to use and instead of having to manually select the correct level of power for your skin tone, the device analyzes your skin tone and makes the selection for you. It literally could not be easier. There's little to no irritation if you use it correctly. If I get lazy and try to use it with any sort of stubble, then it stings a bit. But if I shave prior to use then it's quite comfortable. It's absolutely worlds better than epilating for sure. But that's a different story for a different day. (Ouch.) The one thing that's a little tricky about using this device is that you're not supposed to overlap the rectangle of light, but there's really no way to see exactly where you're placing it because it's up against your skin. Other than that, this is a breeze to use. In the 6-7 weeks I've been using it I've seen probably a 40-50% reduction in hair growth and what is growing is lighter and more fine. I don't expect to be completely hair free even after the 12 week treatment program, but even a significant reduction in hair would be fantastic! Bring on the shorts and tank tops!

review_title: Where Has This Stuff Been All My Life???
review_text: Oh. My. Word. *Excuse me while I go throw away all my regular nail polish.* This is a Game. Changer. I'm a busy mom and honestly, I just hate going to the nail salon, and who has time to wait for 300 hours (Ok, maybe not quite 300) for your regular nail polish to dry, only to smudge it or have it chip within 2 hours? I had pretty much given up on nail polish and just been resigned to the fact that I would have boring nails forever. This stuff is seriously incredible. You just paint it on, cure it, wipe the top with the cleanser to remove the tacky finish, and VOILA! Perfect nails! I did mine last week with this set and they still look AH-MAZING. When this set arrived, I was a bit bummed to find that there's no color included, just base and top coat. I live an hour from the nearest mall and so I couldn't just pop into the store and get a color, and yet I wanted to try it out... Like, right now. I did some reading and found that you can actually use regular nail polish to make a "Gel-y" sandwich. Once you have the base coat on, cure it, then paint your regular color over the top and wait the "300 hours" it takes to dry. Then paint the top coat over the regular color, cure, wipe with cleanser and enjoy your stunning, long lasting nails! The only thing I would change about this set is the light. I wound up buying a larger light because the one that comes with this set is quite small and I wanted to be able to fit all my fingers or all my toes in at once. This light is great for storing and being portable, but I personally wanted something bigger. Overall a fantastic set. I'm never going back to regular polish ever again!
