review_title: Try it, it's kind of awesome!
review_text:
I have white skin. Like, white white.My arms and face generally see a little sun in the summer and darken slightly, but I take care to wear SPF so I never see much change. My legs, on the other hand, are a problem. White. Blinding.Horrifying. I've tried many self tanning products in the past, mostly lotions and foams. They all worked okay, usually with streaking and the dreaded orange tone, but what is a girl to expect?
I can tell you now, there's more out there for us than orange legs. This yea is the first in 3 or 4 that I have actually chosen to wear shorts. I figured, I'm too old to care what people think about my stretch marks, white legs, weird veins. So I bought a Loreal spray bronzer a few weeks ago. I was left with horribly streaky legs that I had no choice but to cover up. I can deal with my own legs, but streaked legs? I couldn't do it. I found this Bronze Doll spray and I decided to give it a try. I've never used a mitt before and I was curious.
I waited until the streaking from the last tanner I tried was completely gone before using this, because I wanted to give it a fair shot. Immedietely upon spraying the product into the mitt and rubbing it on my legs, they were transformed. I can't lie, it looked like I was spreading paint on my chunky white calves. It was almost a purple color. I was shocked, but I kept going. I rubbed the product onto both legs, being as careful as I could. It had a really pleasant scent, almost tropical, but it went away when the product dried. Dry time was about a minute- but I didn't put my shorts on for a few minutes after that. I didn't notice any transfer whatsoever, either on my clothing or my white bed sheets. By the time I went to bed, the color had settled to a nice bronze. Not too dark, but very noticeable. My legs ended up a little splotchy, but I know that it was due to user error. I woke up with nicely tanned legs, for the first time in years.
Then I took a shower. As soon as the water hit my legs, it turned brown. I can honestly say, I wasn't expecting that. I rubbed my legs a little and no additional product seemed to come off. When I got out of the shower, I saw that the color had been reduced by about half, but was still obvious on my skin.I will reapply tonight to help with some of my mistakes from yesterday. This is a dark enough product that I think I can only use it 3 times a week if I want to look normal, and I pretty much do. I love the way it makes my skin look. I love the way it makes my calves (my most hated body part) look! I can't say that I will try it on other parts of my body, but I will being using it throughout the summer on my legs.The mitt makes an obvious (for me) difference in ease and quality of application. I am very happy with this, and I will repurchase it if I run out before September, (which is when I will most likely go back to covering up all the time). I was able to purchase this product at a reduced cost in exchange for an honest review. All opinions are my own. When I repurchase the product, I will happily do so at full cost.

They don't last a super long time, just 24 hours or less, but that's enough for me. **Tip I learned from someone else's review: take out the fasteners before rolling up each curl. Then, once it's rolled up tight, insert the fastener and close it. Do the same in reverse when you're ready to take the curlers out. Take out the fastener, then unroll your hair.** You'll find that your hair will not get stuck or pulled out like it would have if you tried to roll and unroll your hair with the fastener still inside the roller.
Another tip: don't wrap the hair too tightly around the curler. keep it loose enough so that the curler is not squished flat. That way you'll actually be able to put in and take out the fastener. Plus, your hair will dry faster if it was wet before curling.

review_title: Not your father's electric tooth brush or water irrigation machine!
review_text:
Fascinating product; not your father's electric toothbrush, not your father's irrigation water pick.

This is very different electric toothbrush that clearly is different than brushing your teeth, it seems like a much much faster motion and in fact it hums and makes a rather peculiar numbing like sound and feels that way as it is being used.

The Sonicare Floss, is not a continuous irrigation (which probably did not do a lot of good, at least the older models from decades ago), however a more powerful pulse you give yourself between each tooth. Seems clearly more effective than the old style irrigation. I would be reluctant to stop flossing as I cannot be sure how effective this new device might be.

I believe the previous generation (20+ years ago) of electric toothbrushes and water irrigation devices did not do much better if at all than regular and conscientious brushing and flossing; These new products seem very different.

I do not know if dentists use these products on their own teeth or not; I also do not know if there has been a randomized trial between regular toothbrushes and ordinary dental floss vs those who use the Sonicare Essence and Floss machines. At 3 and 6 month, an assessment could be done by a dental hygienist which group had better outcomes. The study could be blinded in the sense that the hygienist would not be told which individual used older vs newer technology. It would have to be a randomized trial, in the sense that a control group that is not on the trial, might not be as fastidious as a control group that is told that they are being compared to the "new technology" group.

review_text:
My 7yr old, and I were so excited to get these to hold her many, many large Jo Jo Siwa bows. I was expecting the ribbon to be a little thicker, and longer. It holds 4 large 8 inch bows comfortably. Possibly 5, however because the ribbon is really thin, it doesn't hang straight when holding, organizing, or using. The ribbon twists around, and doesn't hang straight at all. There just isn't enough space for what we need either. I think these would be great for smaller bows, tho. They look just as pictured. I'm just now learning about the different types of ribbon out there to hold the larger bows more stable. I have not found or purchased a new set, yet. I think if these were longer, it might not have been a complete miss for what I was looking for. The set with the crowns and the ribbon rings as the hooks, do fit over my daughter's dresser draw knobs, which I was hoping, and looking for when ordering. I'm still giving them a 3 star review, because they would be nice for other's needs as I've mentioned. A suggestion would be to make much longer ones. Another foot or 2, and possibly use a heavier ribbon material.

After the infection responded to treatment (debridement, followed by oral antibiotics, Bactrim and Clyndamycin simultaneously) and stopped oozing, I switched from Hibiclens to regular antibaterial liquid handsoap from the grocery store. Hibiclens is a highly effective product, but it contains powerful active ingredients, and must be used with caution.

There will be white streaks that require extra blending if you have rough patches, though, which is why moisturizing first is necessary for me. The main thing is that it is not irritating at all, does not sting my skin or eyes. The whiteness is just a function of its having zinc as a physical barrier to the sun, which is what I want, so finding something that has it without making my face look chalky is a win. It is thin and not bulletproof, so I do reapply somewhat frequently, but there is a lot in the bottle so it lasts. That's another big pro--lasts a long time and isn't as expensive as many others.

These really work. I have deep hollows under my eyes that collect wrinkles when I'm dehydrated and also get puffy and horrible when I sleep poorly or eat late at night or drink alcohol. Anyway, they are the bane of my existence. These eye patches are nice and cooling, first of all, and they really do deliver moisture--and whatever else--through the skin. The moisture--or whatever--plumps the wrinkles and fine lines out beautifully, and removes the baggy puffy thing that sometimes happens to me. I have been using these whenever I want to turn things around within the hour. They stay well enough on my face that I don't have to lie down while I have them on, so I will just walk around with them, or watch a movie on the laptop, and keep them on for an hour. That may not be good, because they dry out a little and aren't as easy to reuse? But I don't really care; the gel-like slippery slimy eel leech silky squish feeling of them is my FAVORITE.

Bottom line: shocking, I know, but these completely work and if you have eye issues, you will be able to see it pretty clearly.

Three stars, because at first glance the texture was perfect, and the smell was really lovely. Unfortunately (actually fortunately for me and my hair) I glanced at the back label before diving in.

Beware: if you have allergies, ask in the comments what's on the label or proceed with caution. It's kind of sad because it looked so nice. I've made the mistake of using products with almond oil in my hair before as it seems to be in just about everything, the result was SO much itchiness and irritation of my scalp and skin. Even here it seemed I'd done my due diligence, now I know I have to take even more precautions.

review_title: Closes firmly, somewhat squeezable, tall and narrow
review_text:
This set of bottles come in a six-pack with blue, green, purple, pink, and two clear. They're fairly standard plastic travel-bottles; they squeeze but they're just a little bit thin and brittle in your fingers. If you want something that will stand up to serious compression, you'll have to look at the more expensive bottles with a more rubberized texture.

The pull spout is a good one; there's a ridge inside that holds it closed, and it takes some significant effort to pull it open. This could actually be a drawback for someone without a strong grip, but it does ensure the bottle won't leak easily and I like the feature. It will wear down over time, but I expect it to last a few years at least which is about as much as you can ask for this price, and the whole lit screws off for refilling and cleaning.

I would have given these five stars, except that the current image is not very accurate. The bottles are taller than it looks in the picture. That was fine for me, since the tall narrow shape fits perfectly with the rest of my travel bottles, but other buyers should be aware that these are about five inches tall.

I have used this to treat some rogue hairs on my face and have been successful. The hairs are on my cheek bones above my beard line, nose tip, between my eyebrows and a single one on my ear. Many of them have not grown back in a month after first treatment. I treat every 1-2 weeks. Whatever does come back I have treated again and there is less to treat each time.

It's more tedious than IPL for sure, but the success rate per treated hair seems good. Also you can be very precise with this.

My technique is:
Grind some salt in a mortar and pestle to get a fine salt powder, put it in a small container with filtered water. Get a small container and put rubbing alcohol in it. For the container I just use a two sided measuring spoon from my kitchen. Maybe an old contact lense case would work good too, just don't use it for contacts after. Clean my face, then use my fingers to spread rubbing alcohol on the follicles I'm going to treat. Dip and wisk the end of the electrolysis pen in the rubbing alcohol to clean it. Get in front of a well lit mirror and table. Make sure the tip of the electrode is perfectly straight and fully extended - - mine was a little curved at the end and needed straightening. Dip into the salt water solution the index finger that is on the hand that will hold the pen. Hold the pen on the plastic parts with your other fingers. Fully insert the electrode into the follicle to treat. Touch your salty index finger on the metal band to electrify the electrode. You will hear a buzzing for a few seconds, then a pause, then buzzing again. The pause means treatment for that follicle is done and you can move on to the next. Though for good measure sometimes I prolonged the treatment of each follicle for an additional 1-2 buzzes, I don't know if it's necessary. Maybe that's best reserved for stubborn hairs. You will see some white puss looking fluid come out of the follicle, supposedly that's lye, which kills the follicle. When done with all of your hairs for the session, take a pause before tweezing hairs and cleaning your face. Here is a good time to put away your tools, brush your teeth or whatever. Sanitize your probe with rubbing alcohol. Meanwhile this will give the lye time to work, let's say it's 5-10 minutes. Then you tweeze the hairs and clean your face. You can use your extra rubbing alcohol to wipe on your hair follicles to help sanitize them.

Another tip, make sure your probe is fully in the follicle during the shock. The probe needle should dissappear inside, and your skin should not dimple inward from the probe pushing it down. Don't touch the skin with the probe sleeve/nozzle, but be very close. You can also use two hands to hold the probe for stability. Your dominant hand can hold the top part of the pen, and your other hand hold the tapered bottom part and brace the side of your hand against your face. I have shaky hands and this helped me to keep the probe in place.

My nose tip hairs seemed to all die out in 1-2 treatments. Cheeks I started with a lot but each time it gets easier with less and less hair. That single ear hair was one and done. Between eyebrows, I started with a bit of a monobrow but it's getting very thin. Overall a success and I plan to continue to treat other areas in the future.

There are only a few reviews on Castle Forbes' Special Reserve Neroli. A couple are on here, a few randomly online. You have to dig for them. So if you're reading this, you're more of a fragrance lover than the average Tommy Bahama fan. Put simply, CF Neroli is not a popular EDP, nor is the brand. You have to know some things about fragrance and have a specific knowledge about neroli itself, to have come searching for Castle Forbes version. This is how I came to know this brand and EDP myself.
My view is that it's not worth the cost of 160USD. That's a lot of money for a 3.4oz. bottle. CF has a nice brand image, the EDP presentation is great, and the quality of the materials used are outstanding. However, the scent alone falls short.
Neroli Reserve starts out wonderfully: crisp orange and neroli, combined with greens like pine, grass and hedges. You feel like you're at the beach, sitting just where the sand dunes meet a lush forest. This lasts for about 20 minutes. Then the "woody/musky" basenotes kick in, and this is where CF got it wrong. It deteriorates into a powdery, barbershop, very British scent. It's something your grandmother (not grandfather) would have worn if she lived in London in 1865. Designer houses today try and replicate this a bit, usually just producing a floraly, loud, baby powder vibe (see MDCI Invasion Barbare). This basenote scent is what then dominates for the next 10 hours, more if you've sprayed any arm/chest hair. The woods aren't masculine woods, just faint tree bark really.
The EDP strength is phenomenal; this stuff lasts. The only problem is whether or not you like to smell like a woman, particularly a powderpuff with flowers. I do get some faint whiffs of neroli, but it's overpowered by the floral powder. I would not recommend this for a man, and unfortunately, would recommend Tom Ford's Neroli Portofino over this. A different vibe for sure (more aquatic), but TF's neroli sustains.
Overall, 3 of 5 stars just because the ingredients are so good, but the scent isn't as much neroli as it is the musky amber that CF used. Bummer.

review_title: Supposed to be a somewhat love / hate scent.  I loved it from the first sniff.
review_text:
I bought this because.............

1.) It gets a lot of reviews on YouTube and Lalique seems to get a lot of respect as a company.
2.) It's supposed to be a good example of a Vetiver fragrance
3.) Vetiver seems to be a big category for men's fragrances.
4.) As a newcomer to men's fragrances, I had no idea what Vetiver actually smelled like.
5.) This stuff is widely discounted and it seemed like a low risk option to learn about Vetiver and answer some of my questions.

So how does it smell? Great! I loved it from the first moment of the first spray through the dry down right up until it disappeared on my skin.

Reviewers use words like "dark, brooding, mysterious, and serious" to describe this. I don't get any of that. It just smells good. It makes me happy. No, it's not a light citrus smell for summer days. It's a heavier, richer smell that's probably better for an evening out.

Personally I find this a lot like the Dolce & Gabbana The One EDP I also bought. The smell is totally different but with both these fragrances.........
1.) I just liked the smell from the first moment.
2.) The concentration is Eau De Parfum for both.
3.) The longevity, projection, and sillage seems similar.

And speaking of performance, this is NOT "beast mode" stuff. It's more subtle. And as a newcomer I'm learning that can be a good thing or a bad thing depending on the circumstances when you're wearing it. But for the most part, subtle is safer and understated is the classier way to go. So for both the D&G The One EDP and this Encre Noir A L'Extreme these impress me as grown up fragrances that come off as sophisticated scents for grown men who wear suits for a living. I think this would be out of place on a guy in torn jeans, sneakers, and a tee shirt.

So performance..........
Longevity - I find it's gone in about 5-6 hours. That's fine. I can always respray if I want.
Projection - Maybe arm's length at most. That's OK. It's not "in your face", it's subtle. Someone needs to be within 3 feet to really pick upon it. If you respray after a few hours you won't offend people.
Sillage - Again modest. I really don't see you offending a room full of people as you walk through and leave them choking and gagging.
Uniqueness - This is not your typical men's cologne smell in my limited experience. It's different. It may get people thinking / wondering about what that smell is. In a good way.
Compliments - I've only asked one woman what she thought and I was surprised that she really liked it. A good start.

Personally, I think this lives up to the reviews and the hype. if this is what a good Vetiver cologne smells like, I like it. I haven't tried the original Encre Noir or the Sport version. This L'Extreme version was recommended as the best and most wearable choice and I'm happy I gave it a shot.

If we're completely honest, we've been conditioned by manufacturers these days to accept rubbish without complaint. Quite true, you can dial into their computer and navigate circles around their voicemail system for a few hours until your anger dissipates. Or is transferred to computer answering systems. Whichever comes first.

Happily, however, such is not the case with the Philips Norelco T980 Turbo Vacuum Trimmer.

Not only does this eager little trimmer solve several problems at once but it does so with a composure and aplomb that will sweep away the corporate fog and, suddenly, everything else you own will seem completely and utterly inadequate.

Trimming whiskers used to be such a chore that the ZZ Top look began to show some sense, if not appeal. The constant recharging, sweeping up afterward, seemingly endless search for single-tasking components that had wandered off and an assembly/disassembly process for cleaning the tool that would make Bill Gates weep. Philips, however, decided to go in a slightly different direction.

For a start, the battery holds on to a charge with a grip that would make Chuck Liddell cry. It doesn't last mere hours, days or weeks. Under standard use, mine lasts well over a month. Even when the battery light does begin to blink, what it really means to say is, "Pardon me but, at some point in the next several days, when it isn't too much of a bother, could you please plug me in for a bit?" Nothing urgent about it whatsoever. And once the lead is connected from socket to trimmer, a scant hour will have it fully refreshed and ready for another month on the road.

Then there is the all-in-one design. Unlike most trimmers, which require that you dig around to find the correct attachment in order to trim your left eyebrow now that you're done with the right, nearly everything is built directly into this sleek little unit. The only exception is a neat little detail trimmer that stands eternally at the ready in its own clear and obvious pocket inside the travel pouch. That's it. Nothing else to search out when you're dashing to work. It's all right there.

Not everyone who sells a "vacuum trimmer" truly means it. Most generate just a bit of wind, sufficient to scatter your whiskers over the widest possible surface. I firmly believe my last vacuum trimmer was designed by a consortium of housekeepers seeking job security. The T980, however, actually captures every single whisker, every single time. And then there's a Turbo button that doubles the already adequate force of the vacuum's suction so that you can give yourself that wind-blown look if you so choose.

But, by far, my favorite thing about this trimmer is the way it feels. It sits in your hand as if it were custom designed specifically for you. It's lightweight and nimble around the bends, falls effortlessly into its case when deeds are done and assembles as if there is an invisible force guiding your hand at every step of the way. I am genuinely amazed at the simplicity of removing and replacing the grille guard. For a time, I thought it must be drawn together by magnets. But it isn't. It's just a set of exceptionally well designed tabs and slots that quickly correct a hurried approach and seat the grille home with a satisfying, subtle click.

Most products on the market today are slapdash clumps of flimsy plastics and mechanics that are carefully designed to fail at the worst possible time. And, for some reason, we have accepted this corporate abuse in the hopes that prices would compensate us somehow. But they don't really, do they? When you've re-purchased the same device five times because it keeps breaking, whose interests are truly being served?

So, then, the T980 is a warning shot fired over the bow of companies everywhere who treat their clients like stupid, slobbering monkeys, devoid of choice or rights. With it, Philips is saying, "See, everyone? You needn't accept rubbish in exchange for your hard-earned money. We've done it properly and at a price point that is competitive." And why wouldn't we honor that?

review_title: They wear out quickly and you'll be buying two a year.
review_text: My review is for this vacuum cleaning a house that has Michigan sand that keeps being brought in from the dogs and even the human shoes. The carpet is a tight knurled dark pattern, and also a couple of area rugs that are low pile, and a wood floor. Eventually the vacuum started making noise after a week. Little tiny noises here and there that reminds you of a bearing that starts making noise on your car's serpentine belt pulley system. I'm a mechanic, so when I heard that noise I instantly knew it was a bearing in the spindle. Or time to get louder and louder and I had to replace it and I bought it Factory Direct. And then that was great and quiet for about a week, and then a few noises and trips here and there of the bearing. Obviously these bearings suck and they're letting dust inside of them or something. No other vacuum we've ever had in the last 25 years in this house has had a problem with the bearings going out on the spindles. And look how many reviews there are. Plenty of high reviews for people that are just glad to have a roller that made their $250 vacuum like brand new again instead of having to go and she'll of a couple hundred dollars more for another vacuum. But the sad truth of it, is that it is a low-quality part even though it is Factory Direct. This is the real deal. No second-hand plastic injection mold factory making knockoffs. It is the real deal. And the real deal just sucks. But I'm going to continue buying two of them a year because this vacuum is so awesome.

I ordered this for our daughter (teenager) who is really in to skin care. She reports that this face cleaner works well and doesn't dry out her skin. She also likes the gel texture.

She wasn't thrilled about how many ingredients the product contains and she said she believes that so many ingredients in one product can't be as effective as they would be if they were applied in the right order separately. review_title: Isopropyl-based hand sanitizer that meets both CDC & WHO guidelines
review_text:
Much of the hand sanitizer we have been using is ETHYL alcohol (ethanol) based. THIS sanitizer is ISOPROPYL alcohol based. Note that historically most hand sanitizer has been based on isopropyl alcohol whereas ethanol has been used in things like alcohol that you drink of as a gasoline additive for oxygenated fuels (for environmental purposes) as well as other purposes. Isopropyl has been used in hand sanitizer and "rubbing alcohol" among other things. Both are now approved for use in hand sanitizer. Ethynol-based sanitzers are becoming much more common due to high demand and supply constraints on Isopropyl-based sanitizers.

The interesting thing is that the CDC and WHO have different guidelines for hand sanitizer effectiveness for these two types of alcohol:
CDC: Ethyl - at least 60%, Isopropyl - at least 70%
WHO: Ethyl - at least 80%, Isopropyl - at least 75%
You can see that it is interesting that the CDC recommends higher concentrations of Isopropyl whereas WHO recommends higher concentrations of Ethyl. Curious. Rather than dig into too many details on the difference, the easiest thing is to find a way to meet both...

The most common ethyl alcohol hand sanitizers that we have been getting (and the most common out there) are 70% -- which exceeds CDC 60% threshold, but is below the 80% WHO threshold.

THIS SANITIZER has an ISOPROPYL concentration of 75% which exceeds the CDC 70% threshold and meets the WHO 75% threshold.

Clearly these thresholds are not hard limits as indicated by the difference of opinion between CDC and WHO, but it is mildly comforting to meet both recommendations if you can do so with no downside or extra expense.

WHAT I LIKE:
* Easily squeezes out of bottle in controlled amount as a gel
* Rubs in easily and absorbs within less than a minute to leave no noticeable residue or tackiness on your hands
* Aloe helps to keep your hands moist, fighting the drying effects of the alcohol
* Small bottles are easy to take in car, backpack, purse, etc.
* Scent is minor and dissipates quickly (we're not using this for its smell after all)

SUMMARY:
A cost effective way to keep you hands sanitized when you can't use soap & water. Meets both CDC and WHO guidelines for effective hand sanitizer formulations.

I own a salon and day spa and was trying these out on my own hair what a mistake I made in doing that. My natural hair broke off some st the rrot as this glue they use is gummy and impossible to remove. I have been doing extensions as a professional for over 25 years. Buyer beware

review_title: I haven't noticed any difference in healing time or easy of stretching
review_text: This stuff is ok. JUST OK. I wont buy it again, as I feel it doesn't really do anything buy lubricate it. I haven't noticed any difference in healing time or easy of stretching. a little bit of water or lotion will do the same thing this stuff does. wouldn't waste my money..

The Colgate Optic White toothpaste is a fine product.  However, this product purchased through Amazon was poorly packaged.  In addition, the purchaser should carefully review how many ounces of toothpaste are in the product before purchase.  Even though you get three tubes, they are very small tubes and didn't last.
Nice diamond artwork pens.
Very pretty hair

[[VIDEOID:d94b46572a263a2fcbefcc0ab5d12b86]] I am glad there are 3 different brushes to use from. I found the silicone brush to be the best for my face because it was soft and gentle on the skin. It's rechargeable and that's a big plus!
Exactly what I was looking for!
Exactly what I was looking for!

review_title: Not All The Instructions Were In English - It's Inexpensive But Not Sure It Works
review_text:
What you get - one bottle of retinol with a dropper

Pros - this had a nice consistency and a little goes a very long way.

Cons - I am just not sure it works. The bottle was half in English and half not. The liquid was a nice consistency but it didn't seem to really make any difference to my skin either moisturizing or appearance.

Overall - it isn't an expensive product but I can't see any difference positive or negative hence the neutral star rating.

What you get - 10 horror style mouth covering temporary tattoos

Pros - the designs are fun and spooky - definitely fit the Halloween bill and look like they would be a great addition to many horror costumes.

Cons - they have to go over your whole mouth which firstly makes it almost impossible to apply well (you know how temporary tattoos can be tricky - this is that but more so because it's over your mouth. If by some miracle you DO manage to get it on and in a good placement you then can't move your mouth at all. No talking, eating, or drinking. I have seen suggestions about cutting a slit in the tattoo - but that just makes it move and fall apart so it's not worth it.

Overall - you get 10 for a cheap price - probably better to put them in a separate area other than the mouth and go for a weird look rather than use it like a mask.

What you get - A basically ready to go (just add jeans) Wayne's World Look including Waynes World Hat, Mullet Wig (with wig cap) inflatable guitar, and plain black T-Shirt.

Pros - While noone even from a distance is going to think you suddenly became Wayne from Wayne's World - this is a fun costume and brings back a lot of fun memories.

Cons - The wig is particularly cheap - but it goes under a cap so not a disaster.

Overall - for the price you would be hard pressed to get all the pieces separately so for me that counts as a win.

review_title: As A Costume Wig You Can't Fault It!
review_text:
So I wear and review a lot of wigs and I have started breaking the review down into sections that I think will be helpful. Note this wig comes with Spider Clip (on large braid in picture), earrings, and a silver necklace (also pictured) - Not pictured - 2 clip in thin braids that I didn't use.

Color - Purple and black - obviously supposed to be a Mary Sanderson look from Hocus Pocus (although hers is a little redder) - not named as such though probably for licensing reasons.

Styling- This is a take out the bag and put on ready to go wig. There is an adjustable band at the back with minimal adjusment but it was enough to fit it securly. The style is perfect and ready to go and needed next to no effort to make it look natural.

Comfort - Fit well and would easily be wearable all day. Super light as the cap is very airy because of the ready to go style.

Overall - I LOVE this. I can't believe for a costume wig this would be so fabulous. It's instantly recognizable and the accessories were a bonus!

review_title: Convenient but I couldn't reuse them.
review_text:
What you get - 4 pairs of ready to wear lashes with adhesive strips already on them (Can be cut to size).

Pros - no magnetic liner or glue to worry about. These do give a pretty decent effect although takes a little practice to get them on.

Cons - I didn't feel they stayed on as well as magnetic lashes do. I wore them for an hour show and they barely stayed. When I removed them there was no way that I would be able to use them again. They just weren't sticky enough.

Overall - might be OK for teens, or people that don't do well with magnetic liner oe eyelash glue but for me they weren't secure enough. For the price though it could be worth a try if you don't normally wear lashes and want them for a special event.

What you get - 2 10ml rollers with Vitamin C serum eye treament for men

Pros - this is obviously designed with men in mind and it doesn't have any scent so my husband was happy to try it out.

Cons - it did nothing even when used for a month. There was no cumulative improvement at all. It seems to be very watered down and you are paying for a lot of filler content and very little active ingredient which is probably why it didn't work.

Overall it seems that you are definitely paying for the packaging and the "male" appeal. It's like the opposite of the pink tax.

What You Get -
12 oz Rose Gold "Beauty begins the moment you love yourself" insulated tumbler with lid.
(Straw and cleaner too)
Scented Candle
Soap
Bottle Opener
Wine Bottle Stopper
2 Flower Petal Bath Bombs
Greeting Card

Pros - This is a really nice, complete gift set. You can send it directly and it comes nicely presented and all the things look really pretty in the box. Because of the bath bombs and soap it also smells lovely when you open it.

Cons - It has a greeting card in it to "Add your special message" but if you send it directly from Amazon obviously you can't do that (they suggest adding your own on the Amazon gift option). Also the card is inside the box - so if you had it shipped to you to give to someone you would still have to open it in order to fill it out.

Overall - this is on sale at the time of the review for under $20 and for that price it is definitely worth it. The cup and candle alone would be worth that.

review_title: Cute Idea But The Horn Isn't Centered With The Ears
review_text:
What you get - 3 Unicorn style spa-style terry headbands.

Pros - these are cute and make a change from the normal bow or cat ear styles.

Cons - The ears don't sit equally either side of the horn and they aren't moveable. The bands are also smaller than others I have. Even though they don't say they are designed for children I feel that these may have been designed that way.

Overall - a little overpriced for what you get but might make fun teen party favors if they are having a spa or make up party.

review_title: No Grips On The Colored Pins but they are cute
review_text:
What you get - a cute tin with 100 bobby pins - 50 multi-colored and 50 black

Pros - if you wear a lot of wigs or you want your hairpins to stand out these are fab. Honestly, I wish the whole box was the colored variety rather than just half of it - and the tin is really cute. The pins are a good size too - not the mini variety.

Cons - the colored pins don't have the litter rubber protectors on the end so they tend to snag a bit. For the price I think they could have had them all colored - not half plain black (which interestingly did have the ends on them)

Overall I will probably continue to use the colored ones as they blend in better with the wigs I use, but wish they had the ends on them.

review_title: It Does Dye - Beard And Skin
review_text:
What you get - 10 packets of dye (no mix needed)

Pros - the dye is ready to go. Put it on - leave it - rinse it out. It does dye the beard - VERY dark - it definitely works.

Cons - the process takes longer than it says on the packet (even the instructions have a longer time than it says) and it dyes the hair AND THE SKIN - which is impossible to avoid as it gets between the beard hairs. The stain on the skin has to fade - nothing got rid of the excess dye on the skin leaving a very fake looking result.

Overall it was a pass from us - will not be using any more packets.

I only recently discovered the trick of using white liner rather than black for some interesting looks. This is a good liner - it doesn't irritate my eyes at all and is definitely good value for money. My only issue is that even with several coats it doesn't look as white, or stay on as long, as some other brands that I have used. Having a 12 pack means though that as I often lose things I have extras on hand which is nice.

review_title: Surprisingly Good For A Costume Wig
review_text:
So I wear and review a lot of wigs and I have started breaking the review down into sections that I think will be helpful.

Color - The color is very similar to the person pictured wearing it in the examples but not the one that is on the mannequin look. This wig is very light silver / grey. It is not that fake, overly shiny texture, and is the same solid color throughout.

Styling- This has an adjustable headband and is fairly easy to fit and style. As it is a costume wig you have to be careful if you are looking to pull it back for anything as the amount of hair in the wig is really designed more for it to be worn as is (which is normal for this kind of price point)

Comfort - This wig is light and comfortable and there is plenty of airflow. This was a little weird around my ears (because my head is a little smaller) but nothing too difficult. This would be suitable to wear all day although I personally wouldn't.

Overall - I really liked it but for what it was - a costume wig. If you are looking for something for a Halloween type look this is perfect.Great for pictures and videos but not one I would probably wear out (other than possibly to a costume party if it completed the look) just because I have others that look way more realistic.

I am not a big traveler but this definitely has the essentials all ready to go in an FDA-approved clear bag. The items are decent quality but probably the most useful things are the bag it all comes in, and a little card that tells you all the things that you should be wiping down, a couple of which I hadn't thought of. I also hadn't thought of taking my own pillowcase before but having seen that it makes total sense. Yes, you could probably get all the things in it a little cheaper, but for convenience, this is a win. (I am also noting it as a possible stocking stuffer present for those people that are difficult to buy for and this would be an alternative to those who chocolate of bath products won't work for).

I have a lot of wigs and crowns and this is the perfect thing to use for styling them! This is the second one I have, and this one allows for earrings to be placed as well (which I personally don't use but I can see how it would be handy for a store display, or if you were taking pictures for selling jewelry). I have named her Rachel, to go with Monica that I already have, and she is definitely a talking point. Great quality, and whilst not the sort of thing everyone would need, cosplayers I think would find her very useful!

review_title: Great Set - Especially For Eye MakeUp
review_text: I use a LOT of makeup brushes - and yes part of that is because I GET a lot of makeup brushes and I am not a fan of cleaning them but it also means that I try out a lot of different brands.  These worked REALLY well for my trickier eye makeup looks. They are soft but they hold the color well and disperse it evenly without much effort. The brush cleaner is a nice addition but being honest I probably won't use it. I do have an automatic brush cleaner if I need one and that will always be my go to.  For beginners or those looking to get a but more technical these are a great brush choice in my opinion!

This lipstick is a really nice vibrant red color and stays on well without being drying. It did have a little bit of an unusual taste, not unpleasant, but enough that I noticed it hence the 4 stars. Other than that the coverage was great, it didn't smudge, and it looked fabulous. I will definitely be wearing it often.

review_title: Cute Color - Bangs Are A Little Long
review_text: This is a cute pink wig. The short waves make it pretty easy to wear but the bangs on it were super long and I had to trim them quite a lot to get it to look good. It is comfortable and would be great for cosplay but I couldn't quite get it adjusted enough for it to become one of my gotos that I would actually wear as a daily option.

I have lots of crowns that I use for various costumes. Full circle crowns are always harder to work with but this was made extra tricky from the fact that there is a very badly placed seam at what should be the front. Although it is sparkly - it is definitely not as well made as many of the others that I have that have been in the same price range. It is described as "Rose Gold" but it is definitely more "Gold Gold" in reality. Overall lackluster and disappointing.

review_title: A Little Hard - But Great Color!
review_text: This set of lip liners are a great set of Reds - and the colors are great. The only problem for me was that they are a little hard which means sometimes they are a little scratchy and harder to get the perfect lines. For the price though you are getting a good selection with pretty much any shade of Red liner you could need.

review_title: Beautiful But Heavy & Not The Easiest To Wear
review_text: This crown is absolutely gorgeous. The detailing is really lovely and it sparkles beautifully. It comes packaged in a lovely blue box which conveniently could double as storage for it.  As with many complete circle crowns the wear and fit is an issue. This is definitely on the smaller size - and it is a little tricky to get it pinned in an acceptable position. The other note I have is that it is really heavy, on the plus side it doesn't feel like it will fall apart with the slightest movement - but between that and the size - sadly it probably won't become one of my regular pieces.

This definitely moisturizes, there is no question about that. I found that because of the texture (it's almost whipped) that you end up needing to use more product than with many of the options. Not sure that my skin would be stressed - but it definitely goes through a lot with the amount of make-up I put on it.  It is supposed to be fragrance-free and there's definitely not a perfume element - but maybe there should be, It smelled weird to me. I can't put my finger on what it was exactly just that I didn't really like it, but I can be picky over scents so that might just be me. Overall it was good - but not great - but also it's a mid-range rather than a higher price product which should be taken into account.

I LOVE Scrunchies - I am so excited that they are making a comeback and this is such a fun way to store them. I mean yes it is a little annoying if the one you want happens to be at the bottom - but not really a big deal. I think it's great that this comes with 8 scrunchies already - that in itself pretty much pays for it - but you can add lots more! If you are a scrunchie person then this is for you. I have mine on my dressing table and I love it!

In England when I was younger, if your eyes were tired or puffy my mum would always tell me to put used tea bags on them. This is what these patches are like! 15 minutes wear and your eyes really do feel better - especially if you are suffering because of too much screen time. Don't be put off by the fact that the instructions aren't in English. Just take out a new pair, place on closed eyes for 15 minutes, and discard. You won't regret it!

review_title: Too big for my little mouth!
review_text: This was just too big for my mouth - no matter how much I squished it.  I can't really say as to whether it would work or not because I couldn't really try it and nobody else in the house thought it looked like something they wanted to try. I am an adult - so feel that this should have been able to be small enough for everyone- but it was not!

This is an absolutely stunning piece that photographs beautifully!  If you try and use it in more of a headband style it is a little pinching but it sites beautifully on top like a crown and looks way more expensive than it is.  Perfect for brides, cosplay, or any time you need a fabulous crown! This is a Tiara style - not a complete ring - which makes it much easier for styling purposes. A wonderful piece and a new favorite!

I have always been a fan of black eyeliner. I never considered using anything else until now. I LOVE how bright this makes my eyes look. The pencil can be used in various ways but by far my favorite is to use it as an eyeliner. It's amazing quality, and although a little more expensive than I would have looked at before trying - now I'm a convert! I can't believe it took me so long to give it a try!

review_title: The Rose Quartz Roller Is Nice ....
review_text: The Rose Quartz roller that comes with this is really nice., and I use it ALL the time. The micro needling kit - not so much. I am assuming that these are supposed to be one use and disposable (as there are NO options for changing/replacing the needle heads) - which could be a good thing in that at least you know for a fact it's clean. I read a lot about this and generally feel that it should be left to professionals! There is no way to tell what shape the little needles are on this (which from reading is pretty important), and there are LOTS of things that can go wrong. I am all about doing stuff at home - but I personally don't think a disposable micro needling kit is one of those things.

These tweezers are fabulous. They grip even the smallest of hairs with no issues. The larger ones are so good that I haven't really needed the smaller ones (although I did try them just so that I could compare for the review). Very impressed! Highly recommend!

review_title: A Good Primer - But Heavy For Regular Use
review_text: This is a great kit, for when you REALLY want your make-up to be on point. The primer gives a really great base and helps the foundation to look smooth and not crack, the ONLY downside is that for me, it doesn't allow my skin to breathe enough and I end up with breakouts if use it more than on the odd occasion which is a shame.  That being said a little goes a very long way, and on the days when I need my make up to be extra perfect then this gives me great results!

These are great! I am a big fan of the liquid liner over the pens. Super easy to use and you can have professional looking lashes in 2 easy steps. This set has a nice variety of lash styles from every day to super dramatic which is nice. They say reusable - I don't reuse mine because my eyes are super sensitive so can't comment on that part but I have seen that lots of people do reuse them so it is probably personal preference but I couldn't say how many uses you might get out of each pair.

This has taken up permanent residence in my freezer. It is great when I just need a quick refresh, oh my eyes are tired, or I have a headache.  I have other rollers too but this is larger than most of them so you can hit more area at once.

I wear a lot of wigs - and am always looking for anything that can make them easier to wear. This product definitely worked, was easy to use, but I am not sure that it is worth the price. I have other items that have worked as well that weren't as expensive.  If this was a little cheaper though it would be fabulous for cosplayers that use a lot of different wigs / toppers.

review_title: Great Pins At A Great Price
review_text: As someone who works with wigs a lot, having various color options is important to me, as these pins generally are only good for one use (although I have used these for a couple of uses before having to ditch them).  Having all the colors in one set is great and very convenient for someone like me - or if you have more than one hair color in the house.

review_title: Very Soft but not good  for longer / thciker hair.
review_text: My daughter has thick hair which sits a couple of inches below her shoulders and takes forever to dry so I hoped these would be a good solution. Sadly although they are super soft, they don't absorb enough if you have longer / thicker hair.  My hair is shorter and thinner than my daughters and although it worked better on that - it still wasn't much better than a regular towel.  Very cute - but disappointing results.

I love magnetic lashes - they have totally changed how I feel about False eyelashes and I use them ALL the time. This set comes with two liquid liners which I love! The lashes stay all day with no issues at all and the variety of styles means you can have them looking more natural - or super dramatic.  The only thing I would say is that they say reusable - and I know people that do wash and reuse them but my eyes are sensitive and so I only use each pair for a single use.

These are very convenient to throw in your purse when you are on the go, especially with everything going on at the moment. Working out at just under $1 a use they are pretty good value for money. They don't have a harsh scent and they aren't drying on your skin which is always a plus. A good product!

review_title: Cute - but not the easiest to style!
review_text: This wig looks super cute once you get it sorted. The bangs are long, and needed trimming, which is pretty normal for me, but this one was a little trickier to get adjusted correctly and I ended up using extra clips to secure it. Short wigs are often harder to work with because there are less places to hide the mistakes, but overall I ended up with a very cute look.

review_title: Nice options but not too sturdy (one of the gems fell off)
review_text: I needed a peacock clip for my vikings cosplay and this worked really well. Having the 3 separate pieces allows for lots of variety and styling options. The only downside is that the glue on one had completely dried up and the gem had fallen off in the packet. Super glue handled that but it did stop it from getting 5 stars.

These are really good purple options. The crayons make it easy to use for underlining the eyes. It was a little tricky to use as a shadow, with more being needed and it definitely took more work to do that, but as a general addition to my make up I was pleased.

The color on these are strong, but they feel a little waxy for my preference. That being said they do stain quite well and there was a variety of red shades which means there would be something for most skin types. Just not one I can see me using on a regular basis.

I used the copper and the white/silver to create the effect in the picture. I love that the color was long lastig and definitely shimmery.  It didn't flake off as some glitter based ones do.  I found the best effect occurred if I let a layer dry and then added more - to build up the shine but if I didn't wait long enough between layers it did get a little clumpy.  Overall a fun addition for the holiday / party season.

review_title: Nice Packaging and a Vibrant Color
review_text: This lipstick is the sort that is great to pull out of your purse in places because it just looks super classy.  The color is nice and vibrant and it doesn't dry out your lips.  The effect is quite matte so I will confess I added a staying gloss over it - but purely for visual effect. My skin tone was failing to pull off the flatter red. It didn't need it for moisture.

I love these headbands.  Perfect to get me in a good mood while I am doing my make up.  Anyone who follows my facebook page would know that Cat Ears are a HUGE part of most things I wear so these are perfect!  Various colors are included. The grey and pink are definite favorites.  Would be a great present for cat lovers, or anyone who wants something FUN while they are getting ready / doing their skin care routine etc etc.

review_title: It Works But Is A Little Tight!
review_text: I wear a lot of wigs for cosplay purposes and am always looking for anything that can make life easier.  This definitely helps grip the wig in place although I did use it with wig clips as well.  There was definitely less slipping around the front area, which can be an issue with them sliding back.  It was a little tight for me and I don't have a big head.  2 hours of wearing it and I was ready to pull it off. For short term use it is a nice addition to have - for if I am just going to be doing a quick set of pictures or a short video, this would never last on my head for the day though,

review_title: Dryer Than Some Of The Other Options Out There.
review_text: I love these easy eye treatments and have used several varients.  This is a little dryer than some of the others used and definitely pulls a little more.  The results are OK but I think it loses a lot from not having the extra moisture left to dab in when you remove them.  Personally I prefer them with a more gel type feel.

review_title: Great Value WIth Good Color Options - And It Lasts!
review_text: This set is great for anyone possibly looking to try a slightly different look.  12 individual, full size lipsticks all in fall / Halloween type colors.  For truer color, as with many lipsticks, several layers work better.  The color lasts really well even through eating and drinking, but comes off easily with remover!

These were one of the easiest mask type products I have used.  The application process literally takes seconds.  Peel off and place on face and they stay there.  I left them on for 15 minutes and could definitely tell the difference afterwards.  As the package describes there is a little residue left when you take them off which yu just dab in.  Over all I was pleased with the effect, but not pleased enough to want to pay $7 for just the one set.

I only purchased the closure. I originally ordered deep wave hair and closure from another vender, however I messed up my closure and I just tried to do a quick fix and order a random deep wave closure else where because it was cheaper. This closure is awful it's looks and feel dry it tangles in the front when it dries while the rest of my hair is still giving me life. I would like to add that shipping was fast. Oh I received my hair on 6/28 and made my wig the next day so it didn't even hold up a month as I write this on 7/9 and its a wig so imagine not taking it off the dam thing prolly would have last a couple day idk just saying.

review_title: Very wet and has 50 sheets! Everyday is a spa day!
review_text: Wow I'm impressed with its packaging and how much collagen it has on the sheet. Easy to put on and with a free mask on it you are not wasting every ingredients it has. Not bad for 50 sheets! Every day is a spa day! I'm inlove.
Does not work
Value for the money. It's worth buying. Every lady needs to have this perfume. Has a romantic smell

I've never worn false lashes, so this was a first. I watched a few YouTube videos on how to put these dual magnetic lashes on. It took like 5 or 6 tries, but on the 7th try, oh my goodness! These are great! I did have to trim the edges a little to fit my eyelids, but otherwise these are amazing. Great invention. I've seen my friends fiddle with glue and I used to think it looked like such a hassle so I stuck with 4D mascera which is a 3-step process. Now that I have the hang of these, it takes less than a minute for each eye and I'm good to go. Absolutely love this lash system. I wonder if there are other styles of lashes available in the dual magnetic type? For the price, it's definitely worth a try. Great product.

review_title: A true color with spark that shows!
review_text: Super fast shipping, under a week. This is as decribed. It stayed on but I did need to reapply in the high heat outside. The color is true
It is good

The best thing about this product for me is the length of the brush handle.  It is the perfect size for me to apply it.  Too often I have tried different mascara's and the brush handle is way too long and make applying it difficult.  Just a personal preference I guess.

review_title: I have the day and night cream
review_text: Works as expected

This stuff is amazing! I have tried so many deodorants that don't have the heavy metals i them but they just fell short and left me stinking. But these have left me dry and pleasant smelling! If odors bother you, I would start with the vanilla coconut one as that one isn't very strong in smell. If you are fasting you might want to use that one instead of the orange one for the orange one got me to thinking of an orange and cream Italian soda and that made me hungry...

review_title: 110 Volt Model isn't as good as the 220V model
review_text: I purchased a 220 Volt model overseas and like that one very well.  This led me to purchase the 110 Volt model for use in the USA.  The action of the 110V model is very sluggish compared to the overseas purchase.  I would not re-purchase this one again, but I won't quit using it either.  Price for refills of the head is pretty pricey not to be completely satisfied.
The bay rum scent is very light, but a little goes a long way and feels good on your skin. Moisturizes nicely.

review_title: Top heavy use hair clips to keep in place
review_text: Had a hard time keeping these on my toddlers head. The top portion seems a bit too heavy to keep them upright. It was more of a hassle keeping them on her head so we ended up not using it but still uses it for her stuffed animals and dolls at play time. Very cute though!

Ok, I do not typically wear hats, head wraps, anything in my head, but due to my recently becoming the victim of a hair coloring debacle, I purchased 2 of these wraps (black and beige) to camouflage this eye-assaulting color. (It was either cover it or stay indoors for a month lol).

As annoyed as I am about having to camouflage my hair for the next few weeks (until I can get the color corrected), I'm equally as pleased with these wraps! They are soft, comfy and super stylish. My go-to style is the top knot - so easy, so fast, so cute! I've gotten many compliments and have even been told I look "exotic" wearing it. Lol. They're a great solution to my temporary problem. I'll probably even wear them after I change my hair color. Very happy with my purchase!
great quality for only $6! This will work perfectly for a Gatsby themed outfit!
Love!
Love this probuct, i have thick wavy hair and it helps smoth and calms down the frizz .
Cream is good, but it has a nasty smell.
Smells great
Exactly what I was looking for.
Excelente
Love it for my curling iron! Have it set on my side of bathroom and it doesn't move!

review_title: Head attachment hinge breaks too easily
review_text: This is the second Sunsonic razor I have bought and both had the exact same problem.  In a short period of time, three months, the plastic molding that secures the spring hinge onto the shaving head has broken.  Otherwise I love the shaver but if you can't use it after a few months, because of a design flaw, it's a waste of money
These are great for filing off the cuticle on your fingernail, fits where other files won't

review_title: For straight easy to manage hair only.
review_text: I should had read the other reviews before buying. The bristles weren't even glued in they fell out while I was brushing my hair. At first I thought I broke it until I checked the other brush and it came out with ease. These brushes are only good for those with fine thin hair not thick or curly. So if you have unmanageable hair like I do I 100% do not recommend you buy these brushes. They are great for my cat and dog though. They love them.

review_title: Not as bright as reviews say and quit working after first use.
review_text: I was skeptical about ordering this and of course I was right.  I was only able to use this one time.  The light would not come on whether it was plugged into the wall or multiple batteries.  However, the one time it did work, it was not very bright.  I had to use the light from my cell phone to make things brighter.

review_title: I love this for my 2 year old

review_title: Human hair, low price, not bad!
review_text:
I purchased this hair to add to my locs and to make loc extensions. When it arrived I was immediately disappointed when opening the package, the hair was yellow and looked plastic. I tried the burning test and it did burn as human hair does, but it was going up fast almost as if whatever was on the hair was flammable. I immediately washed the hair with purple shampoo and it turned out beautifully! After washing I was happy, it wasn't yellow anymore and burn testing again confirmed it was human hair and it had lost that coating the seemed flammable. It has a very nice curl pattern after letting air dry. I bought the 30 inch and I will say that it was disappointing how thin the ends were. Normally hair will thin out at the ends some but this bundle the ends were extremely thin.

Pros: Good price, long length, actually human hair, colors nicely, turns to a beautiful platinum after a purple shampoo, nice curl pattern (kind of like beach waves)
Cons: yellow color (removes pretty easily though), seems flammable before being washed, extremely thin ends

Because of the cons I couldn't give this hair 5 stars, I'd rate it a 3.5 I probably will search for a thicker bundle before I'd purchase this one again.

I had ready this wax is a flexible wax. Yes, all similar waxes flex to a degree but this one is supposed to be a bit more elastic. That's to help it wrap around tricky areas (ankle bones, knees, etc.). It's also supposed to work well for large areas. I prefer to wax myself, and I don't have assistance. I also like to wax everywhere. I waxed my own back with this stuff and it actually worked. I did larger sections, and was reaching behind myself to both apply and remove the wax. It did indeed stretch and flex well so there wasn't any wax or hair breakage. The hair on my back is the typically fluffy vellus hair. It showed up after I had my second and I just don't like it even if it's not super obvious (or even visible 90% of the time). Admittedly that hair type did make it difficult to see, but again this wax wasn't too fussy. I'm 100% positive I applied it in the wrong direction at times and removed in the wrong direction too. Still, worked great.

I also tested it out on my legs. The hair there really varies from fine and barely visible blonde to thicker and quite dark (and rather stubborn to remove in places). It did a decent job on most of my legs. In the areas where the hair is a bit more stubborn I really had to work in smaller sections to get a good result. But in areas like my thighs I was able to do wide areas with ease and little left behind. On my thighs I have small areas that grow in different directions for no reason. I thought I'd have to do second passes, but I rarely did.

All that aside, I don't think this is the best wax for everyone. If you have a lot of very fine or fluffy vellus hair on large areas. Especially if it's on tricky areas like the stomach or behind your shoulders, and areas such as my upper arms where the hair literally grows both up and down in the exact same spot. This will get the job done. If the hair is even a little bit stubborn, you will probably run into some issues. For those places I'd say the pink version (their Best Loved wax) is a fantastic option.

review_title: Perfect for hair while applying makeup!
review_text:
I purchased these to hold back some baby hairs and hair around my face while I put on makeup. I’ve tried using headbands during makeup application but I always forget to put it on until after I start foundation (and then if I put it on I get makeup on it half the time) and worse, it puts funny wrinkles in my hair. So clips are ideal. I opted for this seller, number of clips, styles of clips, etc. because I didn’t want to spend more than I had to, I wanted spares in case I broke some, and I wanted to try both the straight and bow shaped. Most importantly, I needed something quick, easy, gentle on my hair, and yet something that could hold my hair without creating any weird shapes. I was also pleased these were prime so I could get them quickly. These are a smoother, harder plastic than I expected but they absolutely work. Be careful not to catch hairs in the metal part where the two clip arms meet/hinge or you will pull some hair when removing.

I very much would recommend them for the price, the quality, shipping, and matching online description. While they all work, if I was ever repurchasing, I would only purchase the straight ones as the plastic part of the bow shaped clips will start further down toward opening. I found I was more likely to catch hairs in the bow shaped vs regular. All clips arrived well packaged and in great condition. Completely satisfied with my purchase.

review_title: The look of a tattoo without the pain and commitment!
review_text:
I love temporary tattoos. They alway me to enjoy my creative side, without the pain or lifetime commitment of real tattoos. AND I can change them often. I have used the smaller kind many times, but this is my first time with a larger size. When I got them and went to apply them, I noticed there were no directions in the package. I took a chance that it was the same as the smaller ones I had used previously, so I remove the sticky clear paper and applied the tattoo with paper to my arm. I took a damp paper towel and held it on the tattoo for about a minute. I then slowly remove the paper backing. It worked just fine. I did have on little bubble in the design, but I pushed on it a little and it looked liked the rest of the tattoo. This has stayed on very well as I am going on about day 5 and it still looks great. review_title: Just excellent toothpaste (from a toothpaste snob)
review_text:
I am a toothpaste snob and have always bought the best such as Rembrandt, Mentadent, or Crest 3D because good toothpaste (including a Sonicare toothbrush) is so much better/cheaper than dental work.

The Optic White looks unimpressive as just a plain white paste. No stripes, twin tubes, sparkles, or any flavor-bursting crystals or strips. I was not expecting much, but after using it, I am so impressed with this that this will become my new toothpaste. It has a lot of silica in it, so it feels more abrasive than others, but it does the trick (along with some nominal amounts of hydrogen peroxide) to actually whiten my teeth as good or better than any other toothpaste I've used.

It also comes with a relatively high amount of fluoride at 0.76%. This is compared to the Crest 3D at 0.243% (or triple) while the Crest Pro Health lists 0.454%.

Additionally, I've found with a lot of toothpastes such as Crest Pro Health that they contain some kind of ingredient (one of the gingivitis or plaque chemicals) that tends to dissolve my mouth. With those other toothpastes, I get an annoying slough-off of a layer of mouth skin. I asked my dentist, and she said it is one of the chemicals and likely an irritant to my gums. Well, this Colgate Optic White does not have that ingredient yet cleans my teeth really well. I'm sure that Colgate has done their homework, but it is too early to tell if the additional silica will result in increased enamel wear.

Another note about Sparkling Mint is that it is really a bright mint flavor. Your mouth will feel really sparkling and cool which I kind of like, but some may find the flavor too strong.

I would highly recommend this toothpaste.

review_text:
This is a great little headband for securing your facemask if you've either worn a rash on your ears due to bands or just need it a little tighter on your face for a better seal. The little buttons are very secure on the headband and to me don't seem in danger of popping off. I'm giving this 5 stars because it DOES do what it's supposed to (stays on the head, secures bands around the buttons, etc) and feels good and soft but sadly my head/face is just too petite for this to work with a mask so I'm having to stick with my children's sized masks or the ones that go around the back of my head to ensure I don't have gapping around my cheeks or chin. The headband does it's job, masks are just too big/wide for me to actually have them work together.

So it IS a very good product, it's just not enough to solve my personal issue and that's not a fault of the headband so it would be unfair to rate it poorly because of that. In all likelihood for the vast majority of people, this will work perfectly

However, I still use it as a plain headband! I like that it's so firmly in place that I can use it to hold my hair back when I wash my face and do my skincare routine and works great when I'm excercising and don't want a mess of curls flying into my sweaty face. review_title: Good for a gentle exfoliation or those with already good skin.
review_text:
If you need a mild chemical exfoliant and want to cut out products from your routine, this might be the serum for you. It's a weaker concentration of retinol but with that trade, you get a less harsh serum that still keeps your skin hydrated and has a lesser chance of causing irritation. You can most likely use this as a serum/cream combo. Likely a big bonus for those with sensitive skin.

I've taken a break from my usual Tretinoin cream due to the extreme sun in my area but I do still need to keep up with chemical exfoliants and retinol has the added bonus of fighting acne like Tret does. My skin is definitely smoothing out again and looks more even, but it's a very very subtle improvement so I'm not sure if those that have significant texture issues or need a lot of brightening or fading will be pleased with this as it most likely would take a while to see visible results.

It's not a bad product but with such a low retinol percentage it is quite expensive compared to other retinol serums/creams on the market and also comes in a small bottle. I do like it but I don't think it's something I'd purchase myself if only because of that.

review_title: High-Quality Synthetic Hair Extension! Will Buy Again!
review_text:
I was immediately enchanted with this hairpiece from the second I tried it on. I've tried wearing it a few days in a row now, and I'm not tired of it yet. First, I'll start by saying that I ordered it as an add-on item in "dark blue to peacock green." With Prime, it only took two days to get to my house; very fast and convenient shipping, and the hairpiece was encased in a clear plastic bag; I threw that away, as I keep my extensions in a silk hair case. This hairpiece is actually pretty high quality for synthetic, eccentric hair, so I would suggest something like that to keep it safe and untangled when you're not wearing it.

In my opinion, the product images do not really do this hairpiece justice. I can't say anything for other colors yet, but the dark blue to peacock green is pretty true to the product images, with sapphire blue roots and aqua-blue tips (although I will say the hairpiece I received is not half-and-half blue and green like the picture; mine is like an ombre gradient, approximately 2/3 blue and 1/3 aqua tips).

Many of the reviews here also have mixed comments on the thickness of the hairpiece; maybe the people who say it is "thin" are comparing it to their own natural hair? I will say that this piece is very thick for a single-weft hair extension. A weft is like a curtain of hair with a seam holding it all together at the top. I wear extensions almost every day after a butchered haircut took 12 inches of my hair. Authentic human hair extensions come in wefts of varying widths, usually one clip wide or four clips wide, and the hair is very thin because the wefts are meant to be layered on in sections, like natural hair. This blue hair extension is 5 clips wide--wide enough to fasten on your head from ear to ear. Because of my experiences with authentic human hair extensions, I was expecting this blue piece to be thin and underwhelming, but I was wrong and am very happy about that.

I also have an asymmetrical haircut that is close-cropped on one side, so this extension is actually too wide for me to wear across my nape (as the model does in the product image), but I am still able to use it. I curve it to clip from my left nape to above my right ear and it suits my needs and still looks real, despite its unusual color.

Since there is so much hair on a single weft, as other reviewers have stated, this hair extension is a bit heavy. That may take some getting used to, as improper clipping could cause some discomfort and irritation from pulling on the roots. However, once you get practice putting it in, you will learn the best way to clip it without any tugging or pulling of the hair.

It is synthetic material, and while I noticed that mine was shiny, it was not like "Barbie hair," as some reviewers said. I did not need to rub any baby powder in; I just wore it to work for a few hours a day and the shine eventually dulled to look a little less like synthetic material. I will try to add some photos to this page of what the extension looks like in my (straight black) hair. I also noticed that it became easily tangled after a few days of wear. This is not really a problem; I am afraid to brush it too often though, as it sheds (which is normal, but I want it to last).

Lastly, despite being synthetic material, I have tried straightening it on the high setting on my Conair flatiron with success. You can also use a razor or scissors to make any modifications to the style or length, if necessary.

Overall, I think you will be very satisfied with this product if you buy it. I liked it so much that I placed an order for dark pink/light pink and yellow/lime green. These were not add-on items, however, so I will be waiting until mid-August to September to receive these other hair extensions. Hopefully they will be as nice as the blue/peacock green, because I was not disappointed!
